text: A B767 pilot justifies an additional 1500 lbs of fuel added on an intl flight with weather and flight delays.
An MD80 gen oil press low light illuminated after takeoff. The engine was shutdown when the gen did not disconnect. An emer declared with a diversion to a nearby airport.

A B747-400 captain reports that maintenance had pulled a #4 hyd aux pump circuit breaker without collaring the breaker or applying a deferred sticker on the forward overhead panel per the MEL. End result was an overweight takeoff.
An acr pilot notes that his aircraft's FMS contains the scel/scl eslar 3 SID but the eslar 4 SID is current.
A mechanic responds to a B737-300 aircraft that had the AFT lavs 'blue water' overserviced; causing a three by three foot spill in the lavs.
L39 pilot penetrates class a airspace during aerobatic maneuver without clearance.
Zbw controller experienced operror at FL250 during hvy traffic; when issued turns resulted in separation loss; lack of traffic management listed as causal.
A319 captain reports failure of managed descent mode to meet programmed crossing restriction.
Acr on descent at 13000 ft requested turn for weather; ATC denied; flight crew declared emer and executed turn; ATC disagreed with flight crew actions.

Both engine bleed valves of a B757 tripped at FL330 with engine anti ice on causing the cabin alt to climb. An emer descent was begun. When clear of clouds; engine anti ice was turned off and pressurization returned.
C172 flight instructor and student experience runway excursion after landing when student freezes on controls and instructor is unable to overpower her.
Be55 pilot comes within a few hundred feet of parachutists; evasive action is taken to avoid conflict.
Be23 student and instructor experience runway excursion after an unstable approach in turbulent weather.
A PA30 right engine had two cylinders and valves damaged inflt. An engine analyzer used to confirm the power loss cause. The flight diverted to a nearby airport.
Be76 instructor and student experience nmac with aircraft in pattern at coi.
B757 fails to intercept loc for runway 7L at eddf. Frequency change notamed but not noticed by flight crew.  change was not in aircraft database.
Gpt approach controller described conflict event at 2000 between acr arrival and fish spotter aircraft; traffic issued and TCAS RA received; airspace (trsa) faulted.
A CRJ200 FO failed to perform the prestart cockpit safety check leaving the batt off when the APU started. The air driven gen deployed during the power transfer.
A CRJ200 pilot describes repeated unsuccessful attempts to fix a hyd problem. Acr assigned reporter to another aircraft; keeping the refused aircraft in svc.
A330 captain provides example of why he feels his airline has overemphasized fuel savings at the expense of conservative flight planning.
Flight crew of an unidentified acr aircraft twice rejects takeoff due to configuration warning horn. Captain suspects load planning provided inappropriately nose heavy stab trim setting.
Captain and FO inbound to hnl suffer breakdown in CRM due to FO failure to slow to 250K below 10K MSL. Captain takes over PF duties and has FO removed from subsequent flight segments.
B767-200 returns to departure airport due to electrical smell in cockpit.

Pa46 pilot suffers inaccurate pitot static indications after takeoff. Atc fears he will be unable to clear high terrain and declares emergency. Aircraft lands at a nearby airport not FAR from departure airport.

A B757's updated FMC incorporating acars functions has no secondary msg alerting function when operating in a navigation mode. A nordo aircraft cannot be alerted about an ATC contact frequency via an acars msg in the navigation mode.
M20 pilot continues flight into deteriorating VFR based on awos at destination airport. Sneaks under low clouds to a safe landing. Awos still advising the skies as clear.

B737-300 #1 fuel gauge reads empty at cruise. Fuel emergency declared.
B737-700 flight crew takes exception to the attitude of isp approach controller who vectored them into a TCAS RA conflict with a heli and voiced a total lack of concern about doing so.

Notices modest hypoxic symptoms but continues his mission prior to descending after reattaching the bag. Several vertical track errors on descent cause him to rethink the level of deterioration of his flight skills.
An sma inst pilot reports pct approach controller complained his flight contacted ATC too late. The flight followed procedures normal until that time for zzz/adiz flights.

A crj-200 flight crew reports right spoileron indicating an 'up' arrow on the flight synoptic page with the surface stowed on taxi. Spoileron was previously replaced; but required bushings were not installed.
Pa28 transitioning new york class b; with N90; voiced concern regarding ATC handling; claiming aggressive/punitive actions from ATC.
While deviating around buildups; pilot of high performance homebuilt suffers nmac with military ltt. May have been outside of coastal adiz when the event occurred.
Zbw controller experienced operror at FL285 with two aircraft passing one another shortly after assuming the position.
A320 flight crew reports total electrical failure passing 15000 ft during clbout. Ess feed pushbutton is selected; restoring ess power and allowing a safe return.
Da20 pilot experiences low oil pressure in unspecified engine shortly after takeoff. Declares emergency and returns to departure airport.
Crj900 flight crew reports tire failure at rotation causing damage to flaps and aircraft systems. Emergency declared and safe landing ensues.

A lead mechanic conducted a general visual inspection of the nose gear on an emb-145LR (erj-145LR) per pilot's verbal request. Pilot did not make a write-up; and lead did not document inspection prior to release.
Sf34 suffers nmac with sma at 13000 ft MSL.
Md11 flight crew lands after atct had allegedly issued a gar clearance due to the preceding aircraft occupying the runway longer than expected.

text: Sf340 flight crew discovers during climb out that aileron trim operates in the opposite direction from that commanded. Standby trim was used for remainder of flight.

After mechanic smoothed out the sharp edges of a paint chip and bubble at the left static port in the rvsm area; a maintenance supervisor deferred the paint chip and released the B757-200 ETOPS aircraft. An rii inspection was required.

During preflight; pilot of a B737-800 notices the cargo loading system had not been disabled per a required MEL procedure. Placard issued but not followed. Aircraft had flown approx 24 flights since MEL issued.

During preflight of a B757-200; pilot noticed an incorrect logbook write-up and deferral of an ETOPS critical pitot static system failure. The pitot sys was improperly diagnosed. Outbound flight canceled.

Trailing edge flaps disagree msg on approach to a high alt; short runway airport requires a diversion to an airport with a longer runway and command decision to retract flaps partially due to fuel and airspeed constraints.
Sma pilot expressed displeasure regarding handling by ZKC during attempts to secure a pop-up IFR clearance.

During walkaround of an airbus A320; captain noticed fluid dripping from the APU area of aircraft; but contract maintenance and maintenance control appeared to 'pencil whip' his write-up as 'no leaks;' checked APU oil via acars and released aircraft.
Acr flight crew reports departing from runway 8 at tul which is notamd closed with ATC approval. Atc op error is recorded.

A B737-300 pilot reports acars message displayed a new log item they did not enter. Maintenance had incorrectly deferred a fuel stick and fuel gauge for #2 tank. Aircraft should not have been released for flight.
An A320 flight crew experienced ecam flight control elac 1 and 2 alerts. They completed procedures and returned to departure airport for an overweight landing.

Lead mechanic reports his carrier incorrectly loaded the inspection/overhaul requirements for the inboard flap actuators at 10;666 flight cycles. Some actuators were 3;000 cycles past the maximum 10;666 per ad note.
Be55 pilot is informed he has clbed early on teb 5 departure.

Zjx controller described conflict set up by adjacent mil controller when he issued climb through arrival aircraft; reporter issued corrective clearance.

Pilot of a B737-400 with a #1 throttle sticking; raises issue of maintenance using petroleum distillates type sprays in confined cockpit with a low oxygen environment (cabin altitude of 8000 ft).

B737ng captain reports difficulties with eldee 3 arrival to dca and the NOTAM adjustments to crossing restrictions.
Two mechanics assigned the final tasks of adjusting the left-1 door stops on a md-80; were never told that the set screws and nuts were defective and had previously failed a 'running torque.'

Mechanic is informed that an improper documentation issue arose because he did not follow procedures when he installed an autopilot lh mode select panel in their B757-200 borrowed from another carrier.
A B767-300 captain reports being urged to fly an aircraft he feels is unsafe.

B737 departure from bur at V1 is requested by ATC to cancel takeoff; flight crew elects to continue takeoff advising tower.

Instructor and student practicing short field takeoffs and landings aboard C152 experience nmac with cessna shooting a simulated IFR approach opposite direction to their takeoff runway.
M20 pilot and pax suffer traumatic encounter with severe weather on IFR flight. Believe ATC failed to provide vectors for safe passage.

Three mechanics report about trouble shooting and performing high power engine run on #2 engine of a B757-200 for high oil consumption and high oil pressure.

B747 is dispatched in summer heat with only two packs operative. Reporter describes cabin temperature that peaked at 97 degrees during taxi and still 80 degrees two hours into flight.
After a thunderstorm event; an A320 flight crew discovers pea sized gravel in both engine tailpipes. Maintenance is reluctant to inspect the engines and call the incident a FOD event.
A320 flight crew describes 'aircraft shopping' incident and lack of previous crew's aircraft refusal documented in aircraft logbook.

Pilot of a B747-400 reports of uncontrollable high cabin and cockpit temps over 90 degrees for approx three hours in flight. Same aircraft; same condition for two months; numerous write-ups; signed-off by maintenance.
Wdb captain reports that wheelchairs for non-ambulatory pax are placed in jetway prior to deplaning; potentialy impeding rapid egress in the event of an emergency.
A B747-400 was dispatched from a FO airport to the united states with a pack inop; reportedly for the fourth leg. The reporter alleged cabin and cockpit temperatures were dangerously high.

Unable to cool the aircraft after take off; B767-400 returns to departure airport. Maintenance determines an unsecured cargo pallet rolled AFT on take off and its impact with the AFT bulkhead rendered temperature control inoperable.
Indecision as to which approach to fly over mountainous terrain into mfr results in loss of situational awareness and a descent below clred alt.
Pilot struck four runway edge lights on departure from mth.
Captain of unidentified aircraft type reports a gradual increase in cabin alt during descent that is arrested by going to the manual pressurization mode.

Dispatched with only a single mcdu erj-175 flight crew is stymied when it becomes dysfunctional. Must land at a diversion airport account unable to change communication frequencies.
A wake encounter during the landing flare by a C172 results in a runway excursion and wingtip damage.

A B737 departed on the slc twin falls one RNAV with a 10000 ft alt assignment. Atc called the crew after they failed to level at 10000 ft.

A CRJ700 was pushed back from the gate with the nosewheel steering armed. The tow bar shear pins broke.
B737 flight crew is alerted during takeoff that probe heat switches are off and reject to correct the problem.
Misinterpretation of pdc clearance by FO results in flight crew's failure to follow clred SID transition.
An atr-72 FO reported a near prop strike while parking. He criticized ramp personnel for not following procedures regarding equipment within red lines.
A CRJ700 flight crew experienced loss of thrust and ecam right fadec. They declared an emergency; and when egt spiked to 932 degree they secured the engine and continued to a safe landing.
B747-400 flight crew reports tat probe heat failure after takeoff and numerous other unrelated failures during fuel dumping and return for landing.
An emb-145 flight crew experienced a loss of cabin pressure. They followed the QRH; executed an emergency descent; and diverted to the nearest suitable airport.
An A320 captain experienced an ecam message for nosewheel steering after gear extension on approach. Flight crew declared emergency and continued to a safe landing.
A C305 pilot made a forced landing in a field after his engine quit from fuel exhaustion. Slight damage to the aircraft resulted.
Falcon 900 FO pnf reports exceeding the 1500 foot initial level off altitude on the teb 5 SID despite thorough briefing and 1500 ft in the altitude window.

Mechanic reports finding a B737-800 being left completely live after the last flight of the day. Both hyd pumps on; all window heat on; wing strobes on; emergency lights on; fuel pump on; batt on; aircraft unattended.
Two cfi's in a J3 cub each assume the other is flying as the aircraft descends to 200 feet AGL before recovery.
C172 pilot describes mistakes made during night IMC VOR/DME approach.
S56 controller experienced opdev when departure entered adjacent sector without handoff or coord being completed.

A lead mechanic expresses concern about releasing one of their atr-72 aircraft with popped engine oil filter bypass indicator buttons. The maintenance manual is allegedly inconclusive about determining aircraft serviceability in this circumstance.
The pilot of a high performance home built encountered icing at FL220 ft and lost his instruments because of pitot static ice. He declared an emergency and descended to a warmer altitude.

A high performance experimental small aircraft pilot reported unreliable airspeed and pitch information when he flew into clouds at 21000 ft. He was unable to maintain his altitude accurately and asked for a lower; warmer alt.

A319 FO reports anomalous fmgc operation during two consecutive approaches to two different arpts.
An acr captain reported two of his flight attendants were sick before departure but didn't want to call in sick because they were afraid they would be fired.
B737 fa's report using one and a half portable oxygen bottles on a sick pax much to the captain's chagrin. Captain believes second bottle is for fa use during cabin decompression.
B767 flight attendant learns after the fact that a cockpit window shattered during descent and may have caused pressurization issues.
Pa28 instructor pilot experiences nmac with SA34. Invalid communication from ATC trainee may have contributed.
Dispatched with one bscu deferred; A320 flight crew suffers loss of sole remaining unit. Returns to departure airport and is towed to gate.
Crj200 suffers flaps failure. Lands with flaps 20 vice 30.
Sf340 flight crew diverts to a different airport when flap anomalies preclude landing at their original des. Are unable to contact company dispatch/maintenance for assistance.

Cl60 experiences uncommanded deployment and retraction of flaps at cruise.
Cl65 flight crew receives flaps fail msg on approach; complies with QRH procedures; and lands safely.

After completion of a part 135 flight in a cl-300 (bd-100-1a10); two pilots are informed by maintenance control the previous maintenance deferral was not legal and they were required to have a ferry permit to fly.
Crj-900 returns to departure airport due to malfunctioning fuel transfer shut-off valves.

Airbus A300 pilot raises concerns about his company's new policy of pulling all pages of the logbook including the carbon; in excess of seven days old and allowing deferral of an item as inop; against an item required to be functional; that was also downgraded.
B737-700 diverts to a civil airport following a cargo fire warning alarm ultimately determined to have been false.
After late arrival at airport for early departure; flight crew overlooks gear pins on preflight and must return when gear will not retract.

Frustrated by language barrier and malfunctioning ILS signals; flight crew of B747 request VOR approach to 18R which they fly mistakenly tuned to the wrong lagos VOR. Ultimately see airport and land visually.
Sport aircraft licensed pilot experiences nmac in pattern. Believes lcl controller failed to communicate adequately.

On approach; selecting flaps 45 and 3 kts under flaps limitation speed for their cl-65 (crj-900); pilot reports the flaps overspd clacker sounded and continued until 8-9 kts under speed. Other flight crews have allegedlly experienced same issue with -900's.
A PA28 pilot reports narrowly missing an aircraft talking with ATC while the reporter was coming onto the frequency.

Low time private pilot severs a small tree with the prop of his C172 while taxiing on a grass turf airport. Determines it is safe to fly and does so without consultation with maintenance. Later learns the flight was in violation of an ad which specified a more stringent interpretation of the sudden stoppage criteria.
An A1-b pilot's tail was blown airborne by a helicopter's downwash causing the prop to strike at hto.

A qc inspector reports that a cabin pressure controller was changed on a dehavilland dhc-100 due to popping the circuit breaker when placed in the 'auto' mode; but did not realize that an rii was required.

Two days after replacing a failed air data module on a B737-800; a line mechanic realizes the rii inspection was not accomplished on the adm quick disconnect fitting. No rii reference in maintenance manual.
Upon arrival at destination; an md-80 flight crew is informed by maintenance personnel at the gate the aircraft had departed with known damage in the AFT cargo hold.
B767 flight crew reports generator drive failure and inability to start APU; causing diversion to nearest suitable airport.
Md80 experiences close encounter with traffic deviating weather who was at the same flight level to which they were descending. Atc advised he was not talking to the traffic.
A pa-44 pilot shut down an engine for training but it would not restart. Pilot landed and was able to restart the engine on the ground.
An MD80's emer exit lights were inop on preflt and after a maintenance signoff were still inop at the next station.
C130 experiences nmac with T1. Believes TCAS gave inappropriate RA commands.

During preflight; a check airman notices extensive use of speed tape on the seams of their b-777 along the left forward side of the aircraft belly. No record in log book or deferred items. Aircraft taped to address vibration issues.
Bad weather and a failing engine convince B767-300ER flight crew to divert to more benign conditions.
A320 flight crew reports receiving no documentation of maintenance required being performed on their aircraft prior to departure.
A B777 was dispatched with an excess of dry ice by acr shipping agents who did not understand the limitations or the kg to lb conversion process.
B737-700 diverts to a civil airport following a cargo fire warning alarm. Met by local leo demanding captain identification; including ssn.
A320 green system hydraulic failure is predicted by low quantity indication. No ecam warning until gear is extended for landing. Advance preparation limited the impact on a timely arrival.
B747-400 experiences APU fire warning upon reaching cruise alt. Follow QRH procedure; dump fuel and return to departure airport.

Dhc8 abandons approach when nose gear fails to indicate down and locked. Previous unassociated delays combined with trouble- shooting the nose gear result in ultimate landing with minimum fuel.
Mke controller described opdev when failing to issue needed turns to a departure aircraft that entered adjacent airspace without coord.
Da42 flight instructor and student land with gear up.
A B737-800 flight crew experienced loss of trailing edge flaps and landed with leading edge devices only.
Vfr PA28 transitioning sna's class c airspace; with sct; experienced nmac with B737 believed to be sna arrival no traffic issued by ATC; evasive descent initiated.
C182 pilot reports runway incursion by another cessna at 0s9. Both pilots on CTAF; pilot departing does not see or hear C182 pilot approaching.
Captain of unidentified acr aircraft declares emergency and returns to departure airport following #2 hydraulic system failure.

After instructing a maintenance technician to relamp a mode control panel on a B757-200 using the mode control display panel per mm 22-11-0; a lead mechanic learns a different mm requires a cat-3 check when replacing a command switch.
A mechanic describes the method he used to replace an airbus A320 engine egt harness.

Mechanic changing a #1 main tire on a b737er; fails to notice the two letter designator 'er' on the removed tire; was a special type required for this particular airplane. Correct tire was installed approximately twenty days later.

A lead mechanic describes how a B767-200 cargo system circuit breaker placarded item was incorrectly entered in their maintenance system history as information; which resulted in the placard not being properly deferred.
While looking for an exit that was already behind the aircraft following a low visibility landing; pilot of PA31 taxis off end of runway striking a taxi light with the right prop.
Piper J3 cub pilot experiences runway excursion into adjacent grass area after abrupt rudder input.

One of a flight of two war birds initiated a go around conflicting with traffic on short final; after separating on downwind following an overhead break; ATC alleges aircraft should have landed together.
An M20E pilot lost all electrical power on descent for approach and used a hand-held gps as backup.
Ztl controller experienced operational error at FL200 when failing to recognized a developing loss of separation following an incorrect readback of assigned altitude.
A BE40 experienced an uncommanded roll to 90 degrees while dsnding thru 15000 ft at 290 kts with the autoplt on.
show: 2008-10 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: Ce680 flight crew departing teb on the teb 5 exceeds 1500 ft prior to 4.5 DME.

Captain of A319 reports confrontations with GND personnel regarding appropriate maintenance procedures to dispatch with the APU generator deferred inop. Experiences incompetence; irrational behavior; insubordination and possible intoxication.
A B737 pilot reports wake turbulence at FL230 10 NM in trail of a B757.
E170 flight crew accepts routing direct to cyhz. They later discover the route takes them beyond 50 miles off shore.
Dhc-8-400 flight crew reports uncommanded rapid landing gear cycling during descent from FL240 at 280 knots. Gear doors never actually open.
B737-500 captain reports lack of taxiway signs at boi as contributing to a taxiway incursion.
A crj-200 encounters wake turbulence during approach to atl.

A dehavilland dhc-8-100 maintenance controller questions his manager about an unsigned; anonymous memo inserted into their maintenance control procedures manual; stating the passenger door handrail struts were not an rii item.
A crj-700 flight crew deviated from the charted track on departure from dca and violated the p-56 naval observatory restricted area.
An A320 flight crew climbed through their assigned altitude when the altitude capture feature of the autopilot failed.
A pa-44 pilot taxied across a runway hold short line due to unfamiliarity with the airport and relying on his passenger to read the chart.
Ifr sma declared emergency because of engine problems; diverted to nearest airport; questioned ATC services; I.E. Vectors away from landing airport.
Sma taxied off the pavement when trying to exit the runway on an intersection that was slightly behind the aircraft; alleging ATC's instructions contributed to the event.
An A300 flight crew lost pressurization control in climb because they had the APU bleed switch in the on position.
A pa-44 pilot noticed a gear unsafe light on in cruise flight. Atc declared an emergency for him and he was able to extend the gear using the emergency gear extension.
Ramp controller described event when acr crew failed to call before taxiing after pushback contrary to ramp operational procedures.
A B737 flight crew noticed a burning odor in the cockpit that was noticeable in the cabin also. The source could not be determined so they declared an emergency and landed normally.
show: 2008-09 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Initial Approach
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: A EMB145 crew was notified after take off that a vapor trail was seen as they departed. No evidence of fuel leak was seen by the crew in flight or after landing. A crew the next day said the aircraft was ferried for maintenance.
An air carrier pilot reports that a plastic fork broke as he was attempting pick up a salad piece hitting him just below the eye.
A320 captain finds improper maintenance placarding of MEL item. Feels such errors are increasing.
B737-400 captain reports second instance of finding both light bulbs missing from csd warning lights during preflt.
B737-300 gear warning lights fail to respond to gear extension. Crew employs manual extension procedure and finds access doors difficult to open.
An A319 understood lax lcl controller to say position and hold runway 24R. The crew was performing the takeoff chklist and misunderstood. Aircraft on final given gar.
Pilot of a B767-200 reports the forward left main entry door fell out of the up-latch onto a gate agent who was meeting the aircraft at the gate.
Md90 captain asserts RNAV departure from slc fails to take aircraft performance limitations into account.
show: 2008-10 · Procedural: Published Material / Policy · Initial Climb

text: Citation flight crew experiences altitude deviation on departure after clearance was changed and distractions ensued.
The captain rejected a takeoff at 80-90 kts when a B757 left generator failed.
A B757 spoiler eicas light intermittently illuminated during preflight and while holding short for takeoff. Maintenance could not repair nor explain why the alert was occurring.
Crj 200 flight crew on departure has adg deploy.

B737 landing at las prior to reporter's B737-700 fails to hold at appropriate hold short line btwn parallel runways; thus failing to clear the active runway. Lcl controller fails to make note of error.
A319 captain disputes maintenance controller's interpretation of a cabin att's pocket penlight being the dispatch 'equivalent' to an inoperative emergency exit flashlight.

B737-500 flight crew receives notification via acars that dangerous goods are onboard; they request the appropriate form and are told the dangerous goods did not make the flight. Upon post flight walk around; dangerous goods are discovered onboard.
A B737-300 EGPWS 'terrain; pull up' alerted climbing through 1000 ft after takeoff. The circuit breaker was pulled. Later; on approach at dest both FMC's failed. Failures not related.
A BE350 entered runway 25L on taxiway g after missing the hold short line. A new taxiway ac and confusion at the irregular intersection of wg; g; and runway 25R may have been a factor.
Cl65 captured a false lga 22 loc and GS causing alt and as devs as the aircraft pitched up and accelerated.
After maintenance performed a cabin odor troubleshooting and air conditioning pack burnout check; an md-80 requires an air turnback due to white smoke in the cabin during climbout.
show: 2008-10 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Parked
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: Captain; FO and cabin crew of an emb-190 notice a glycol like smell in the aircraft just after takeoff. Excess grease from nose landing gear was found in the pack air intakes; the fuselage underside and wing-to-fuselage fairing.
A C152 on a cross country lost power at 8500 ft and was able to land at a nearby airport.

Mechanic reports they have been doing AFT pressure bulkhead t-cap replacements due to being cracked on their md-80 aircraft. Same size fasteners were reinstalled with only verbal approval; but later considered unacceptable.

While taxiing from the hangar to the terminal with only #2 engine and APU running on an airbus A320; mechanic reports he lost nose wheel steering just when he was cleared to cross the active runway. Brake steering control unit (bscu) is suspected.
During a walkaround; mechanic notices the right (#2) nose landing gear tire axle washer was missing on a B767 aircraft.
A MD11 crew reports two low speed rejected takeoff's; first for flaps not set and then a gen drive warning. The crew was distracted by a tire press low alert.
A B737-800 with an asymmetric flap warning on approach; diverted to a nearby airport with a longer runway. An emer was declared.
A b737ng flight crew found during preflight their crew oxygen bottle supply valve was only half open. They had already flown one leg because the bottle appeared to check normal.
A320 flight crew makes error entering cleared route in mcdu ... J80 vhp J24... Instead of ...J80 mci J24 ... Error is noticed by zid controller.

text: A Q400 departed with the cargo and baggage loaded AFT so that immediate forward trim was required after takeoff.
show: 2008-10 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: A B757-200 pilot comments that flying with an MEL'ed engine gen on a precise profile the aircraft landed with 2300 lbs less fuel than planned.
A Q400 flight attendant is extremely fatigued after five long days of flying and during a turb event fails to secure a trash container. The container came loose on landing.
A B747-400 captain taxied onto an incorrect runway after being distracted by a shoulder harness issue. He lost sa before resuming aircraft ctrl from the FO.
An A319 crew reports manually entering the dca eldee 3 RNAV arrival into their FMC but missing the revue 15000 ft restriction.
show: 2008-10 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: A captain reported misinterpreting a NOTAM closing his destination airport. He diverted to another airport after checking awos.

text: Pa28 and SW4 have nmac on approach to diverging runways at slc.

Mechanic reports about installing classic B737-300/500 nose tires on a next generation B737-800. Classic nose tires they had inadvertently installed; had tire covers indicating they were next generation type.

A pilot landing at gai properly announced his arrival on CTAF. Sma holding for takeoff acknowledged the call but took off forcing reporter to gar. The departing sma was a student pilot who misjudged the arrival aircraft's distance.
Pa28 arrow tries to power out of the sand on the end of a grass strip and breaks nose gear strut.
A mechanic and inspector report about a required pitot/static system leak check that was not performed; after an air turnback of a B737-800 aircraft; due to losing captain's airspeed and altimeter.
Bell206 on descent for landing has nmac with another heli.
Zkc controller described operational deviation when departure aircraft made unexpected turn into adjacent airspace; nearly conflicting with another aircraft.
Advised of a missing cargo net during an intermediate stop; captain of E190 is concerned that prior flights may have been made without the nets.

B757 captain is concerned about acr willingness to dispatch into forecast significant weather areas while militating against the captain's authority to add fuel to account for predictable delays that could result.

While reviewing the maintenance work on an emb-140; a lead mechanic realizes the 9 pints of oil added to #2 engine by a mechanic; requires an external leak check that was not accomplished prior to departure.
A300 returns to departure airport when flight crew smell smoke in the cockpit.
show: 2008-10 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Climb

text: Turbulence below 10000 ft MSL on descent causes flight attendants to take available pax seats for the landing rather than risk continuing to their jumpseats.
A B747-400 taxied on ypdn's runway 29 overrun while on a 180 degree turn onto that runway's overrun area that is not intended for heavy aircraft.
Cl60 flight crew fails to comply with crossing restriction on descent.
Aircraft landing runway 14 at srq heard ATC go-around instruction to another aircraft; then observes light aircraft overfly from intersecting runway.

Small single engine aircraft on practice gps approach to runway 13 at baz experienced a nmac with overflying VFR small single engine aircraft that was instructed to follow; ATC issuing corrective action.

Citation flight crew has an altitude deviation while encountering unforecast destination weather accompanied by FMS issues and diversion airport problems. Second alternate recommended by ATC proves to be the answer to a very busy flight.

Small single engine aircraft practicing short approach procedures at laf was instructed to follow traffic on a one-mile final; turned base following the wrong aircraft; resulting in an ATC initiated go-around to another aircraft.
An LJ35 flight crew experienced a pressurization problem climbing out of 38700 ft. They misunderstood their clearance to a lower altitude and descended below clearance limit.
show: 2008-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: A B737 captain reported two ramp personnel dangerously close to his engines on taxi in at dfw.
A maintenance supervisor and mechanic describe why they believed that a category-3 recertification was not required for an 'hgs fault light illuminated in flight' condition on a B737-700.
C550 has a runway incursion at kcpr.

A maintenance controller directs maintenance to remove a broken seat back at an emergency exit row of seats; on a B737-300 and defers item. Controller realizes later the restrictions on seat back removal at exit rows and has seat replaced.

After replacing the #2 inertial reference unit (iru); mechanic forgets to include the completed operational check paperwork in the work package. As a result; the B737-300 category-3 status was not recertified nor downgraded as required.
Sma awaiting departure from maf reported apparent confusion on the part of the controller; alleging conflict when takeoff clearance was issued with helicopter on the runway.

Zob controller described conflict near FL210 when departure aircraft turned direct aco after maars; contrary to SID routing; requiring controller intervention to maintain separation; controller alleging multiple occurrences.
A B737-700 stab trim motor failed at the start of the arrival descent. An emer was declared and the flight diverted to a nearby airport with a long runway.
A B757's left gen failed resulting in the loss of left ac; left ac transfer buses and opening the bus tie isolation breaker. An emer was declared.
Zid controller described opdev event when revised routing was issued to an aircraft; entered into the computer; but computer failed to accept corrected data.
A flight attendant questioned whether a sleep apnea device was legal for use in flight.
show: 2008-10 · Flight Deck: Passenger Electronic Device · Cruise

text: C172 pilot uses tow bar to move aircraft and forgets to remove it prior to flight. Discovered on landing; no damage occurs.
B737 departing runway 1R described conflict when traffic departing parallel runway drifted towards departure path; questioning simultaneous departure procedure.
B757-200 was dispatched with right fuel gauge deferred; flight landed with a 2500 lb fuel imbalance.

A small aircraft pilot at hyi reports an aircraft landing runway 31 when six aircraft are landing runway 35. The jet then back taxied on runway 35 unannounced on CTAF and caused a nmac as aircraft executed a gar.
The smoke alarm in a B757-200's lav by door 2L sounded after takeoff. An emer was declared with a returned to land. An electrical smell was present.
A B757 encountered wake turbulence behind a heavy aircraft on approach to ord runway 10 and slowed the approach speed after ATC gave an assigned speed.
show: 2008-10 · Inflight: Wake Vortex Encounter · Initial Approach

text: A dhc-6 pilot found his control column movement was restricted by the maintenance 'can' that was stored near the column.
Fighter pilot reports missed approach after GS failure with ceiling much lower than reported by atis. Missed approach altitude is exceeded by 1200 feet.
Emb145 captain reports brake failure after pushback allowing aircraft to roll into taxi light before control is regained.

A B737-800 flight crew experienced severe engine damage in cruise flight. They shut down the engine; declared an emergency; coordinated with dispatch and maintenance; and diverted to the nearest suitable airport.
A C172 experienced a nmac with a C182 at heg.
Acr captain provided a detailed report regarding a high speed abort caused by a bird strike; listing; shaking; yaw and engine power loss prior to the abort.
P50 controller experienced operator error at 9000 ft while attempting to vector and climb a departure above an arrival; alleging iwa arrival procedure contributed to the event.
Dfw ramp controller expressed concern regarding an air carrier flight crew's failure to comply with ramp communications procedures.
Mem controller described an arrival aircraft frequency problem that complicated a combined position operation when a flight crew made repeated calls to establish communications.

A line inspector is informed he failed to report an upper fuselage doubler of more than twenty inches existed on a B757-200 as required by their engineering order. The inspection was accomplished months earlier; during the night; outside on a cherry picker.

Mechanic reports a B767-300 had an air turnback for left hydraulic quantity decreasing from hydraulic leak. Shortly after meeting aircraft on active runway; two main gear tires overheated and deflated.
Fuel-oil cooler failure results in oil loss on B777-200.
A mechanic describes the efforts and frustrations of removing a hi-lock fastener with a missing collar and stripped threads of a previous repair at the #1 engine pylon of a B757-200.
Military pilot described nmac at 3000 ft with unreported VFR aircraft while conducting practice approach procedures at nip; voicing concern regarding traffic congestion in the area.
A pitts S2B pilot experienced a nmac with another aircraft in the pattern at lwm.

Mechanic reports about an air turnback of a B757-200; after he replaced the forward outflow valve. New valve installed; was found not effective for the aircraft; but the same valve passed all required maintenance tests.
B737 flight crew reports going off course on the obrln1 departure from cle after passing djb for unknown reasons.
show: 2008-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: Lear 45 flight crew reluctantly accepts a clearance with traffic 1000 ft above maintaining visual separation. Tcas RA is subsequently received and flight crew complies.
A CRJ200 crew is confused by the complex pre-takeoff procedure to clear a 'spoileron fault' status light. The captain fails to notify maintenance after the flight.
B737 flight crew reports runway excursion at approach end of runway 24L; lax; after taxi back due to poor lighting and lack of familiarity with taxi route used during construction.
Crj-700 captain reports contacting a tug with left wing while being marshalled into the gate with a wing walker in position.
Acr captain reports phantom TCAS alert and RA while climbing out. Atc reports no traffic in the vicinity. Circuit breaker reset eliminates problem.
show: 2008-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: Sf340 captain reports main accumulator pressure cycling between 2000 and 3000 psi in flight. Flight crew elects to return to land; the system had been previously written up.
B777 captain is restricted to 250 knots in climb for traffic and is unable to convince ATC of the need to accelerate to 260 knots for operational reasons.
Sf340 flight crew is advised on landing that a previous flight crew may have started an engine with the prop lanyard attached. Flight is canceled and maintenance dispatched.

B737-300 departure from runway 28 at bwi was instructed to cancel takeoff clearance because of spacing with traffic landing on runway 33L; reporter alleging an immediate takeoff clearance should have been used.
Acr flight crew reports TCAS RA and nmac with light twin approaching dnw at 12000 feet. Acr is arriving and twin is departing jac using the dnw 267 degree radial.
show: 2008-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: B737 flight crew reports captain's sliding window cracking at FL270 approaching top of descent. Flight crew declares emergency and lands at destination airport.
An A320 ecam alerted 'anti-ice f/o' and 'engine 1 reverser fault' at 400 ft after takeoff. The flight returned to land. A landing gear disagree alerted after landing.

During a right-hand overwing slide replacement on a B767-300 aircraft; ten circuit breakers were pulled. Two circuit breakers were inadvertently pushed in by technician; which caused slide deployment during battery pack connection.
An acr pilot is concerned about uncontrolled airport operations while their aircraft's TCAS is inop and about CTAF airport runway incursions during acr operations.

A mechanic reports about tail damage caused; when the vertical stab and rudder came in contact with the left hand vertical stab of another dhc-8-400. Not following procedures when moving aircraft in the hangar cited as cause.
Dash8 flight crew reports taking runway as twin cessna lands opposite direction during early morning departure at CTAF airport. Cessna had canceled IFR but not announced intentions on CTAF frequency.
B737 captain reports csd failure enroute which is replaced by APU generator. Later APU fails and flight crew diverts to nearest suitable airport. Communication difficulties with dispatch reported.
Sf340 flight crew reports standby altimeter and airspeed severely off in cruise. Post flight reveals bent pitot tube.
Da900 captain reports alt dev while maneuvering with tcs button depressed. Reporter is new to efis and vertical tape altimeter and not aware tcs button disconnects autopilot pitch as well as roll.
show: 2008-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A corp pilot dsnding into env is told right-6406A is not hot. At 8000 ft ATC stated that sfc to 11000 ft is always restricted. Available publications do not state 11000 ft to FL580 may be released by range ctrl; but that sfc to 11000 ft is always hot.
show: 2008-10 · Airspace Violation All Types · Initial Approach

text: A CE650 departing on the teb 5 SID was distracted by a flap retraction problem and clbed to 2000 ft before dsnding to 1500 ft.
show: 2008-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Climb

text: Zhu controller described TCAS RA event that resulted from an aircraft failing to meet anticipated climb rates and an aircraft who was on the wrong frequency.
Acr captain reports taxi instructions received during landing roll at abq are not clear. Flight crew exits runway 3 on runway 12 before becoming reoriented.
Air carrier captain reports first officer not lined up with intended runway and getting too low on approach. After go- around is initiated tower issues low altitude alert.
Mci controller described event when aircraft was cleared for visual approach to ixd but started approach for ojc; corrective instructions issued through ixd tower.
show: 2008-10 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An acr pilot was confused by the numbering system and location for two gates; and started to taxi to the incorrect gate.
Pa46 pilot reports altitude deviation after confusing auto pilot disconnect button with ptt button. Layout is opposite of aircraft reporter normally flies.
show: 2008-10 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An acr pilot discusses the loud and unnecessary raas warning as the crew lines up on the departing runway to hold for crossing traffic.

B737 captain suspects fuel gauge error when arrival fuel and uplift fuel do not equal gauge fuel. Error is traced to inaccurate acars entry by arrival crew. Reporter believes fuel slip should show start fuel and uplift.

A320 captain is unable to obtain ground air at gate; therefore he starts the APU and cancels ground air request. Captain returns to aircraft to find air connected and APU off. Captain is very displeased with ground crew.

B767 flight crew report inboard aileron stuck in the 50% up position after take off. Eicas flight control display indicates that aileron does not move in turns. Communication difficulties prevent maintenance involvement and problem corrects itself.
Captain reports false raas 'on taxi way' call during takeoff on runway 29 at ktn.
A B737-700 crew rejected a takeoff because at 80 kts the airspeed disagree flag was visible. Previously; a 50 kt airspeed difference was noted in flight.
An acr maintenance decision allowed a B737 to fly during dark conditions with both landing lights and one runway turn off light inop.
A B737-300's cabin alt warning horn sounded at FL340. The crew dscnded to FL240 and gained pressurization ctrl.
A B737-800 maintenance log restricts the aircraft to heads up guidance cat iii apches only. Flight release allows cat iii autoland. Maintenance restriction is in error.
A B737-500's cabin alt warning horn sounded in cruise at FL330. After manual cabin outflow valve selection pressurization control was regained.
A B757-200 rejected a takeoff at 70 kts for a gen eicas warning. After an idg oil svc the aircraft departed normally.
A B747-400 FO executes a gar in a windshear at 200 ft. With the autothrottles engaged the aircraft achieved 280 kts while leveling at 4000 ft.
A B757 captain reports terrain pull up warnings on final and assumed a GPWS error. He was later notified the altimeter was set incorrectly.

A mechanic contracted by his carrier to replace a blown outboard tire and brake assembly on the left main gear of another carrier's B737-800; was told by the borrowing carrier's maintenance controller he had a one time approval for the replacement.
A BE23 instructor initiated a gar after his student bounced the landing. The student raised the flaps causing a loss of lift and the nose gear collapsed as the aircraft hit again.

text: A sfo acr push back crew did not maintain communications with the captain during push back after being told to remain clear of taxiway.
A military flight instructor twice verified an assigned altitude of 3;000' with ATC but after a gca go around and level off at 3;000' was told the assigned altitude was 2;000'.
Citation v flight crew experiences conflict with traffic not on an IFR clearance while in IMC.
C182 pilot inadvertently enters cos class c airspace without clearance.
C172 private pilot and cfi departing 2w6 at night have helicopter at midfield intrude upon their runway while departing.
Emb170 flight crew refuses aircraft with MEL that causes 'engine 1 fuel lo press' warning; due to lack of specific language allowing this message to be ignored.
Dispatched with the left generator deferred inop; B737-400 must divert when APU generator goes off line due to an overspeed.
A B737 crew failed to see the second pdc page which included a las SID revision; and so after takeoff turned the wrong direction. Atc gave immediate vectors.

Mechanic reports he failed to have quality assurance (inspection); verify the standby altimeter leak check on an ATR72 aircraft; as required by their procedures manual.
B717-200 flight crew fails to perform approach-descent checklist and level off low due to mis-set altimeter.
A light twin aircraft on the arrival to ugn made an erroneous FMC smart turn early near veena intersection toward the ugn runway 23 iaf. Atc gave the aircraft vectors out of ord airspace.

An MD80 flight crew flew through their assigned alt when they were distracted by an electrical problem.
While performing a high speed taxi of a beech 1900; to trouble shoot a pw turboprop PT6A-67D- #2 engine; the captain and first officer noticed the engine torque was erratic.
A decathlon pilot took off without his fuel caps properly secured after refueling.
Sparks; smoke and an electrical smell from floor board vent were reported by B757 pax. Flight crew declared an emer and diverted.
Da40 instructor and student report runway incursion at zzz. Reporter claims that intrusive traffic alerts by G1000 are an issue in the incident.
A CL600 flight crew evacuated their aircraft in response to an alert from the ground controller that they had an engine fire.

Mechanic reports an annual inspection of their cessna-172 noted the airworthiness directive (ad) to inspect the pilot and co-pilot's seat back support brackets for cracks had been missed on two previous; 100 hour inspections.
An AA5 instructor and student pilot were unable to maintain their assigned alt because of lack of power and downdrafts.

text: Arriving dash 8 flight crew reports conflict with departing MD11 at intersection of taxiways.

N90 controller described minimal separation event when an A340 made a wide departure turn followed by a second A320 who turned inside the A340; requiring immediate vectors; suggesting additional separation required with this scenario.
An md-82 flight crew noticed they had no 'landing gear safe' indicating lights after gear extension. They declared an emergency; verified the gear was down with the periscope; and landed normally.

Two mechanics report on events that contributed to a crash ax not being transferred from a removed first officer's seat to the new replacement seat on an ATR72. The aircraft was delayed at a downline station until another ax was located.
A grumman A65 instructor and student on a right down wind for pne runway 24 had a nmac with an aircraft released by tower.
An A319 flight crew departed with hazmat onboard but no hazmat paperwork.
A B737-700 flight crew experienced a front lavatory smoke alarm. They declared an emergency and returned to land at their departure airport.

A B737 crew missed the pdc clearance change from a LOOP4 to a oshnn departure which is the usual clearance off of the lax runway 24 complex at night. Numerous preflight distractions occurred.

A B737 #2 engine cowl and anti-ice wing control circuit breakers popped after takeoff in icing conditions. A brief electrical smell with smoke was present.

text: Crj 200 flight crew receives a flap fail cas message on approach.

An A320 received an engine 2 stall ecam after the engine rpm rolled to idle then recovered. An emergency was declared as the engine rolled to idle and a descent for landing begun. A fadec fault was indicated.

While replacing the right hand AFT position primary light assembly on a B717; a mechanic is distracted with other multiple maintenance tasks. He later realizes he forgot to install the screws that secure the light to the already departed aircraft.

A B767-300 captain is asked by a ground agent if the cargo door is closed. The cargo door light is not MEL'able and the captain later realizes its operation should have been confirmed because of the agent's uncertainty about the door's position.
Md80 flight crew at FL300 has left generator trip offline; they declared an emergency until successfully starting the APU at 10;000 ft.
B757 flight crew reports engine failure at FL360 and diversion to nearest suitable airport.

A maintenance director reports of an inadvertent overfly of the initial eddy current inspection required by a hartzell airworthiness directive (ad) note 2008-13-28 on a piper seminole turbo PA44-180T.
Be400 pilot experiences nmac with bonanza on departure.
A dash 8's nose landing gear failed to extend. All gear extended after they were recycled once.
B737 flight crew departs sna using performance data that has expired. Query to dispatch reveals data is current and date is typo.
Flight crew reports possibly landing on wrong runway during cat iii at sea.
Confrontation develops between passenger; cabin attendants; passenger service personnel and the flight crew over the carriage of passenger supplied personal oxygen.

An air carrier pilot comments that ATC altitude constraint clearances with more than one constrained fix in a single clearance can cause crews to miss down track altitude constraints because of work distractions.
