text: A cargo pilot notes that the den airport diagram constraint for aircraft turning at taxiways m and M2 is misleading and only applies to aircraft exiting runway 17R/35L on M2.

While removing old tape and sealant with a scotchbrite disc and damp rag of acetone at the AFT pit threshold plate on a B737-300; mechanic reports the rag caught on fire; setting off the deluge system and damaging two aircraft.
A B767-300's right engine bleed valve tripped and would not reset. Because enroute requirements mandated dual bleeds; the flight returned to land for maintenance.
A PA60 pilot was distracted because the gear up light did not illuminate after takeoff. While trouble shooting the problem in weather and turbulence an alt deviation occurred.

An A319 missed the eldee three doccs intersection 15000 ft assigned crossing restriction because the runway approach was added to the FMS after the arrival restriction was entered causing it to drop out.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: Be10 pilot reports landing on closed runway due to NOTAM not being available from commercial flight planning service. Pilot reports poor service from fss as the reason for using this service.
An A319 crew comments about pilot desensitization to pdc routing changes when the standard pdc repeats the filed clearance after the term 'revised' but no change is made.
A mis-programmed self parking system incorrectly stopped an A320 60' beyond its assigned space and caused the #1 engine cowling to miss the jetway by 6 inches.
A crew departing san was forced to raise their voices to ensure positive aircraft transfer and required repeated ATC clearances while taking the runway because of raas alerts.
Zkc controller described conflict event at FL350 when aircraft reported cracked windshield; initiated a descent; resulting in less than standard separation.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: An A319 assigned runway 36R as they taxied onto 36L did not fully re-program the fmgc for the new runway. As a result the captain had no airspeed bugs nor proper reduced takeoff thrust.
A wdb in yssy with passengers and crew aboard was sprayed with two insecticide sprays; one for each the cabin and the cargo hold then forced to remain for 15 minutes in the closed cabin.

A zspd local controller instructed an aircraft to position and hold three times with another aircraft on the runway. Two times the aircraft held short. After the third instruction; it became clear the controller meant hold position (short of the runway).

An international wide body arrival to sfo was cleared for the approach immediately upon contacting norcal rather than close to the intercept. The crew failed to arm the approach mode and had an airspeed deviation as a result.

A B737 first officer described a visual approach to las runway 1R with parallel traffic on 1L. Tcas alerts prevented him from flying the descent rate he would have liked until he offset and flew an angled final.
Failure to obtain green gear safe lights traced to open air/ground relay circuit breaker by B737-400 flight crew.
An air carrier crew describes a position and hold clearance cancellation and the confusion that occurred when multiple ATC clearances were mixed with multiple raas alerts.
An A320 flight crew experienced an equipment cooling fan fault; followed by ecam for avionics smoke. They elected to return to their departure airport.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Initial Climb
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: A B757 crew slightly overshot its FL350 cruise altitude. After descending down using a slight thrust lever reduction the aircraft entered a stall buffet. Autothrottles and VNAV may have malfunctioned.

A B737-300 crew reports missing a crossing restriction in an aircraft with an FMC but no moving map. Situational awareness is decreased and other navigation information must be used to complete the picture that a map provides.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: B747-400 stab greenband warning illuminates on pushback. Maintenance defers nose gear sensor. Anomalous airspeed/pfd data on landing causes flight crew to suspect aircraft was heavier than advised by load planning and that the warning may have been accurate.
A B737 captain reported encountering severe turbulence over powder on the powder 5 arrival to den; which kicked off the autopilot and rolled the aircraft 60 degrees.

During preflight planning; pilot discovers that maintenance control had not placarded a crack found in the forward cargo pit ceiling of a B737-300; and no one called maintenance to inspect it and complete the required deferral procedure.
Ea50 pilot reports icing encounter in aircraft not equipped with wing anti-ice. Several equipment failures are also reported.
An MD82 flight crew experienced brake over temp warning on takeoff roll and rejected the takeoff at approx 100 - 110 kts.
An AA5 pilot experienced airframe and carburetor icing and stated ATC could have been of more help.
Corporate jet flight crew deviated from their cleared SID on departure when the pnf failed to notice the changes in their route specified on the pdc.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: A light transport jet pilot reports a near miss and a TCAS RA climbing out of bmq as radio contact was being established with ATC to get an IFR clearance.
An MD88 flight crew experienced smoke in the AFT cabin shortly after takeoff. They declared an emergency and returned to land at their departure airport.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Initial Climb
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: An MD80 flight crew experienced an oxygen leak from the captain's mask. They descended to a lower altitude and diverted to the nearest suitable airport.

A maintenance inspector is informed about not signing for the correct orientation; nor the verification of; a wing anti-ice duct clamp next to a wiring harness; at the wing fueling bay door on a B737-700.

After replacing the fwd engine's faulty fuel pump on a cessna-337; a mechanic is informed the pilot made an emergency landing. The hydraulic and fuel vent lines were inadvertly crossed during line reinstallation.

After working an overnight check; a right pack problem and a #2 engine ignition fault on a B737-300; a mechanic is informed he failed to reinstall the left hand ignitor plug shroud and left two screwdrivers on the inside of the engine core cowl.

During a close up spotcheck of an aileron installation; a mechanic found the right-hand aileron attach bolts for the mid section and outboard section were installed incorrectly on an atr-72-200. Two other mechanics and two inspectors also report on the installation.
A MD11 iro reports a number 2 engine malfunction on approach. The engine was shutdown and the next takeoff was aborted because #2 engine was not responding properly.
A PA28 pilot experienced alternator failure and attempted to conserve battery power by turning off the radios and squawking 7600.
Ce550 flight crew misinterprets silow1 departure; intending to maintain 1550 feet until 4NM east of pxr. Departure instructs immediate climb to 7000 feet for low altitude alert.
Crj700 flight crew descends below their clearance altitude before ILS glide slope capture on an ILS approach.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: An A320 first officer reports an EGPWS 'pull up' alert during a day VMC visual approach to las runway 1R. He had difficulty determining the aircraft's height above the terrain visually.
Flight crew of small turbojet transport fails to remain east of ord 345 radial on pal-waukee 2 SID from pwk.
show: 2008-11 · Airspace Violation All Types · Initial Climb

text: Emb145 flight crew discovers the first officers FMS database contained a SID that was not effective for seven more days.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Right thrust reverser was deferred by line maintenance on a B757-200. After pushback; the flight crew notices incorrect circuit breakers collared; coordinates with maintenance control and resolves the situation.

A maintenance controller reports an emb-145 was not able to pressurize in flight after contract maintenance inadvertently safety wired the outflow valve in the 'open' instead of the 'closed' position. Aircraft diverted.

After extended taxi crj flight crew contacts dispatcher to reduce min takeoff fuel; only to find out they have pushed back with the wrong fob to begin with. Dispatcher contacted the station to upload more fuel; but the station neglected to relay the message.
B737 flight crew departing lga on LGA2 maspeth climb make a right turn to 180 degrees then a left turn to 340 degrees. Two right turns are required by the SID.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A FMC equipped corporate jet crew on the teb jaike2 arrival missed the jaike intersection crossing constraint of 13000 ft because they programmed ilene for 13000 ft.
show: 2008-09 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: An acr crew was told to maintain 170 kts but slowed while configuring on approach. Tower requested the assigned speed be resumed as instructed.
A IFR C210 pilot distracted while helping his passenger with a communications issue; deviated from the assigned altitude by 600 ft

An m-20K entered and accumulated un-forecast icing while descending into its destination. The pilot missed the approach and flew to his alternate with full power; gear up. The landing gear was extended over the runway's end.
A B767-300 crew reports declaring an emergency and returning to land after a hydraulic pressure low eicas alerted a hydraulic system failure.
A B767-300 crew failed to reset the aircraft's altimeter to 29.92 while climbing and troubleshooting a hydraulic system failure. Atc reported the flight 400 ft off altitude.

A B777-200 generator did not come on line after a delayed takeoff start. Upon return to the gate for maintenance; an incorrect MEL sign off allowed dispatch. In flight the crew discovered the maintenance sign off error.

A PA46T pilot executed a missed approach after a low visibility approach but failed to reengage autoplt. The aircraft did not level at the assigned altitude and flew through the assigned heading. Fatigue was a factor.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: A B737-800 diverted to a nearby airport after declaring a low fuel state emergency. The intended destination's runways were closed for an emergency and the reporter's aircraft stabilizer trim was inoperative.
Ztl controller described loss of separation event near FL250; caused when one aircraft lost pitch control; climbed; resulting in TCAS RA event.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Climb

text: Mechanic reports an A320 arrived with a veering to the right problem. Only after replacing the steering servo control (6GC) twice; did they realize the vendor overhauled steering servo units they installed were also defective.
A beech V35 pilot landed gear up because he did not complete the gumps checklist while smoothing a rough running engine prior to landing.
show: 2008-11 · Ground: Gear Up Landing · Initial Approach

text: B747-400 captain reports substandard takeoff performance on military charter flight.
Faced with strong gusting crosswinds to a short runway; the fatigued flight crew of a B747-400 is refused their desired landing runway at ord.
A11 controller experienced operational error when B737 lost separation from preceding heavy aircraft on final; corrective vector action was too late.
A320 flight crew reports uncommanded cargo compartment fire bottle discharge during baggage unloading.
A320 flight crew departing from sna expressed concern regarding ATC's runway use decision given the multiple wind shear reports by departure aircraft.
An encounter with 'jet wash' during approach to hou results in injuries to cabin attendants.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Wake Vortex Encounter · Initial Approach

text: An air carrier pilot describes a four day trip that flies the first three days as all nighters and ends the fourth day with a long multi-leg daylight flight. Extreme fatigue results from circadian rhythm effects and lack of sleep.
A B737 crew flew an unstabilized approach to a landing after ATC kept them high prior to the arrival.
During low visibility operations using smgcs; an aircraft was cleared into position and hold; then cleared for takeoff with the stop bar lights illuminated.
B757 flight attendant reports boarding through doors 2L and 3L simultaneously; and does not believe this situation is covered in their flight attendant manual.
Md80 flight crew reports encountering thunderstorm and hail after accepting heading from departure to avoid weather.

Mu2 pilot reports failure of fuel to transfer from tip tanks and missed approach due to weather. Pilot receives low altitude warning from ATC during approach and gets immediate vectors to zzz due to low fuel after missed approach.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Landing

text: Md88 captain reports smoke odor just after take off. An emergency is declared; QRH complied with; and an uneventful landing ensues.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Initial Climb
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: A gulfstream ii departs on the teb runway 24 SID with 2000 ft set in the alt alerter. After leveling at 1500 ft and turning to a 280 degree heading the crew clbed toward 2000 ft but dsnded back to 1500 ft after ATC questioned the climb before 4.5 DME.
An EA50 crew is pressured into flying in known icing conditions in order to get the aircraft to its base.
Grumman AA5 pilot reports engine running slightly rough and returns for landing. While talking to the crash crew at the tie down; a fire is detected in the engine and quickly extinguished.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Cruise
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: B737 freighter captain discovers after landing that the aircraft contains 4 more pallets than are shown on the manifest and weighs an extra 10;000 pounds.
Air carrier flight crew reports missing change to filed route on pdc and has a track deviation.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: A319 captain reports being instructed to start number 1 engine using external air and discovers during push back that the air cart was located near that engine during start.
A casa 212 flight crew noted their right engine was not producing normal power even though all indications were normal.
B767 flight crew reports crossing ILS critical hold line for runway 26L at eddt. Runway 26L lacks regular hold line.
Zdc controller experienced operational error when zny unexpectedly refused additional aircraft; reporter alleges requests for help from two supervisors went unabated.
King air flight crew enters IMC on departure without an IFR clearance.
Mitsubishi MU2 flight crew executes a circle-to-land at rvs to the northeast; where the procedure is not authorized.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Small aircraft pilot reports rapidly deteriorating weather which blocks attempts at diversion and results in safe landing on state highway.
B777-200 departure from ord; during intersection runway operations; described distracting event when ATC called attempting to hurry the aircraft through the intersection.
B777 FO believes safety is compromised by the use of two tower and ground frequencies with the new runway at sea.
An air carrier pilot reports that satcom does not work in most areas of south america. Air carrier maintenance insists satcom works in flight but reporter believes that it will not.
Cl601 flight crew exceeds 1500 ft prior to 4.5 DME on the teb 5 departure.

B737-700 captain reports lost communication shortly after take off. All radios are rendered inoperative by an apparent short in the captain's communication panel. A single radio is eventually regained and the flight continues to destination.
An A320 crew detected a strong electrical smell coming from around the captain's glare shield. An emergency was declared with a return to land.
A dhc-8 lost the hydraulic fluid in its #1 hydraulic system. An emergency was declared and the flight continued to its destination.

Air carrier departure from atl voiced concern regarding ATC taxi clearance to runway 26L; devoid of specific guidance for transitioning from taxi way f to e; ATC's indifference and attitude cited as problematic.
A B757-200's pressurization failed to function climbing through FL360. An emergency descent was begun at FL377 with a cabin altitude of 10000 ft. The crew returned to the departure airport.

An A319 pilot questions whether low maintenance staffing levels and time pressure contributed to his carrier's mechanics replacing a scavenge pump on the left engine; when the right engine actually had the history of chronic excessive oil consumption.

During a B737-700 preflight the FMC message 'single FMC operation' was canceled and considered to be a startup nuisance. After takeoff the crew discovered first that only the left FMC was operable and later that the right FMC did not have current software.

A captain receiving crj-900 initial operating experience mis-programmed an ATC crossing restriction in the FMC. The check airman flying in the right seat missed the error so the aircraft was high at the intersection. Fatigue was a factor.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: A B757 flight att reports the cockpit security barrier by door L1 could hinder evacuations because people and objects are impeded by it.
B767-300 flight crew reports activating stick shaker in descent at maneuvering speed with spoilers extended and turbulence present. Flaps 1 ends the warning.

A319 captain reports while in an open descent at 190 knots landing gear is extended and flaps 2 selected. Aircraft pitches down and exceeds 200 knots before autopilot can be disengaged resulting in a flap overspeed.
A320 flight crew is informed of smoke in the cabin by flight attendant. Smoke decreases as thrust is reduced and crew elects to return to departure airport.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Climb
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: An air carrier operations staff was late supplying takeoff performance data to an A320 crew. As the hurried crew completed a checklist and entered the data; they incurred a runway.
Check airman describes events surrounding missed approach at omfj including chart errors and difficulty with ATC.
Air carrier first officer laments the juniority and lack of adherence to regulations of some captains that she flies with.
An hs-125 pilot reports climbing to 2000 ft on the teb 5 departure at 2.3 DME. An extended GND delay preceded the takeoff and caused a distr.

Sna controller voiced concern regarding sct's practice of routing VFR traffic along the shoreline requiring sna local controllers to issue altitude restrictions on IFR departure aircraft; listing safety concerns.
B737 captain reports multiple incidents of other flights exceeding safe operating speeds and separation with other aircraft on congested and/or wet/icy ramps.

Electing to shoot touch and goes despite atis reports of low level wind shear and moderate to severe turbulence; pilot of small retractable gear low winged aircraft makes touch and go on a taxiway adjacent to the tower vice the runway.
Apparent failure of the central air data computer causes MD80 flight crew to declare an emergency and divert to a nearby airport.
Beech 400 suffers altitude deviation and loss of separation when pitch trim fails at FL240.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Conflicting airspeed indications late in takeoff roll cause saab 340 flight crew to return to their departure airport. Post flight inspection reveals captain's pitot tube damaged and bent approximately 45 degrees from normal.
A B747-400 captain reports wake turbulence at about 800 ft behind a B777 on takeoff at vhhh.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Wake Vortex Encounter · Initial Climb

text: Regional jet flight crew accepts visual to runway 33 at dca but executes go-around when approach becomes unstable.
A sick passenger and an airspeed anomaly on short final are distractions that cause boeing 717 flight crew to fail to obtain a landing clearance on their second approach subsequent to a go-around.
An air carrier pilot reports difficulty determining that the end of geg taxiway 'a' turns right 90 degrees before a not-well-defined and abandoned no-taxi run-up area.

Canadian regional jet flight crew fails to follow prescribed anti-ice for takeoff procedures and rejects takeoff due to a wing overheat message. Wing skin is damaged during GND run-up chks by maintenance.
Sf340 flight crew executes a missed approach after receiving only two green gear indications on approach; during the published missed approach they overshot the altitude by 400 ft.

Dehavilland Q400 departs with maximum takeoff weight limited by enroute climb (metw) below proposed take off weight (ptow); a paperwork violation. Because anti-ice was not required enroute the pragmatic impact was nil.
A300 suffers pressurization failure following airfoil anti-ice valve anomalies.
Beechcraft king air 200 makes emergency landing when both engines flame out.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: A tlh local controller asked a light transport crew if they could keep a small aircraft in sight. They applied affirmative but had a nmac at the near intersecting runways thresholds.
Glf4 suffers loss of separation while turning over an inbound RNAV waypoint for which a crossing restriction had been given by ATC.
A B767 flight crew failed to set standard altimeter climbing out of 18000 ft when they were distracted by a hydraulic problem.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: B757 flight crew reports flap disagree at flaps 20 position during approach. Flight is continued to landing by first officer at captain's behest without referring to QRH.
Ztl controller described nmac event when IFR traffic level at FL240 climbed into IFR crossover traffic level at FL250; climbing traffic alleging aircraft pitch problems.

Zhu controller described suspected operational deviation event when aircraft was either given the wrong center frequency and/or switched to the incorrect frequency; all leading to suspected airspace violation.
A BE55 pilot declared an emergency for a low fuel state when he was forced to fly a longer approach than planned.
Md80 flight crew reports inability to pressurize during climbout. Crew is able to manually control pressurization but flight attendant reservations induce crew to return for over weight landing.
A C320 pilot lost all electrical power and was unable to lower the gear. He made a gear up landing with no injuries.
After wing anti-ice system fails; CL65 flight crew elects to maintain high speed below 10000 feet in compliance with company flight manual to minimize ice build-up. Atc is informed and approves.

Pilot reports they were dispatched with MEL 24-1 for a left engine driven generator (idg) inoperative on a B757. After arrival; they were made aware of undocumented work performed to reconnect the idg at their departure station.
Crj700 flight crew is jarred from their reverie at FL370 by the autopilot disengaging and the stick shaker coming on.
Dhc-6 diverts to another airport with longer runways due to nose gear not centering after extension.

While first officer is on lavatory break; MD80 captain is cleared to descend to FL330 and reads that back but sets 300 in the altitude alerter. As first officer returns and aircraft is leveling at FL300; ATC queries crew about their altitude.
Zfw controller voiced concern regarding D10 tracon's frequent late acceptance of handoffs; citing possible equipment issues and facility operational practices.
A mechanic reports missing a separate deferral on the GPWS after deferring the left inertial reference unit (iru) on a B757-200 aircraft.
A pilot was crossing an active runway at szp when he observed another aircraft on takeoff roll approaching him. They passed within 100 ft of each other as both took evasive action.
A high wing light aircraft in the pattern at awo experienced an nmac with a low wing aircraft entering opposite direction traffic at the same airport.
A high wing light aircraft experienced an nmac with a light twin in the vicinity of opf.

A PA28 pilot failed to secure the right fuel cap before takeoff and noticed the cap was gone and fuel siphoning overboard during climb. He returned to departure airport to locate and install the fuel cap.
Grb local controller described conflict when arrival was vectored through departure corridor; visual separation procedures were applied.
An LR35 flight crew deviated from the cleared SID because they were unaware of a NOTAM affecting the SID routing even though they checked the normal sources.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: A C177 experienced an nmac at haf when he took off without allowing proper spacing to an arrival aircraft who executed a go-around.

Mechanic reports on the results of reevaluating damage to the AFT cargo door skin of a B737-800. Original damage measurement was accomplished at night; with only a flashlight; 12 inch ruler and depth gage and considered to be within the srm limits.
Mechanic reports he installed an HF coupler meant for a B757-200 in an airbus A320. Operational check using the mcdu passed. Unit later replaced.

A B737-500 pilot reported that; during normal landing gear extension the nose landing gear indication showed a red light with the gear handle in the down position. Maintenance found grease caked around the nose gear lock sensor. Aircraft was released without an rii inspection.

Be100 flight crew reports elevator freezing (literally) in cruise at 17000 feet. Descent to lower altitude and warmer air allows normal control to be regained. Faa review discovers that first officer is not part 135 current on this aircraft.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: A ce560xl flight crew clbed above 3000 ft departing teb and the captain thinks it may have been contrary to their clearance.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: A BE58 pilot experienced smoke in the cockpit from the janitrol heater. He shut down the heater; declared an emergency; and returned to land at his departure airport.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Climb
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: Sbr-1 experiences encounter with opposite direction traffic when radio communications with center are compromised.
Mechanic assigned to perform a maintenance de-dock on a B777; failed to remove circuit breaker collars and reset the same breakers called out in the work card.
An SF340 flight crew operated with the auto pressurization controller deferred. After landing the first officer depressurized the aircraft abruptly with the manual system.

An MD83 flight crew found their landing gear would not retract and showed three red gear unsafe lights. They put the gear handle back down; got three green; and returned to land at their departure airport.
A hawker horizon flight crew experienced engine vibration climbing out of FL300 and elected to divert. On the ground N1 fan blades were found to be damaged with indications of bird strike.
An MD83 flight crew experienced dual pack trip from duct overheat in cruise flight; resulting in loss of pressurization. They descended to a safe altitude and regained control of the packs.

Mechanic called out to look at a forward cargo door for dents on B737-900 aircraft; used the length measurement instead of the width measurement; when he applied the w/y formula in the srm for determining allowable damage.

A C421 pilot entered the runway for an intersection takeoff and turned the wrong way on the runway initially; in part because his compass was reading 180 degrees off because of air conditioning operation. He caught his error and turned around.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: Husky pilot with instructor on board reports nosing over at very low speed causing prop damage.
show: 2008-11 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A320 captain is informed; after the fact; that a crew applied MEL was not correct for the fault that was deferred.
B737-800 captain feels light buffet at FL360 and notes airspeed is in the minimum maneuver speed yellow range. Thrust is increased and descent is initiated to regain airspeed.
Pa32 pilot reports encountering mountain waves which exceed the aircraft's ability to maintain level flight; both ascending and descending.
Embraer rj suffers alt dev on approach when the autoplt attempts to capture a false glide slope.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: Sf340 flight attendant reports actions and preparations after being informed of an emergency landing; by the captain; for an unsafe landing gear indication. Landing is normal.
A320 flight crew is informed by the cabin attendant that a seatback has failed. A willing passenger is found to situation in a flight attendant jumpseat for the remainder of the flight.
Widebody returns to departure airport when landing gear fails to retract.
Canadair regional jet experiences flap fail message on approach to a short runway.
Cabin attendant on a full B757-200 reports multiple passenger safety boarding violations for which inadequate staffing was a contributing factor.
Miscommunications between flight crew members resulted in unauthorized and uncoordinated IFR departure from sps developing into a traffic conflict.
E190 captain reports striking novelty balloons on final approach.
Improperly performed deferral procedure results in A319 returning to departure airport due to failure to pressurize.
Dc8-73 flight crew experiences loss of control at start of takeoff roll when #4 engine fails to spool up in concert with others. Control is regained and takeoff is safely rejected.
show: 2008-11 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: An MD11 had dual fadec failure resulting in a stalled condition at FL410. An emergency was declared with a landing at a nearby airport.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: Acr flight crew receives terrain; terrain warning while performing loc approach to runway 33 at jst. Ils was notamed out of service.
Cabin attendant finds bolt securing her jump seat safety belt to be unsecured.
An emb 145 flight crew noted early in takeoff roll #1 engine would not produce takeoff thrust and rejected the takeoff.
B757 flight crew reports altitude deviation after receiving TCAS ta approaching level-off altitude.
Emb145 flight crew neglects to set the local altimeter setting descending through FL180; resulting in an altitude deviation.
A300 captain reports a single tire failure after landing with an apparently malfunctioning brake.
A c172rg instructor pilot reported his student retracted the gear on the runway while executing a touch and go.

Instructor and instructor under training in the front seat report altitude deviation on go-around while waiting for wing man to rejoin. Instructor under training cited lack of recent flight experience as primary cause of deviation.
Rdu controller expressed concern regarding adjacent sectors' unwillingness to approve and/or accept traffic that was encountering turbulence; eventually resulting in additional icing and turbulence.
Pilot lead of flight of two military fighters reports miscommunication and assumptions that lead to descent from assigned altitude in zla airspace.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pa28 pilot reports nmac with cessna at 1500 feet while attempting to join the downwind leg of the traffic pattern. Pa28 pilot is alerted by the cessna pilot.
A mechanic describes some of the factors that he believes contributed to his installing the wrong fleet type vertical navigation (v-navigation) software on a B737-300 aircraft.
A320 flight crew reports discovering brake wear pins on preflight that indicate brakes worn beyond limits. Contract maintenance and company attempt to fudge the signoff and maintenance release.
B737 first officer reports rolling delay that causes crew to decline the final flight of the day due to exceedance of FAA maximum 16 hour duty day. The crew schedulers do not see it that way.

C172 instructor and student report generator failure that goes undiagnosed until the battery is nearly depleted. Pilots return for successful no light no radio night landing. Tripped circuit breaker caused the problem.
B767 flight crew reports stand-by attitude indicator failure over the atlantic enroute to south america and elects to divert to nearest suitable airport.

Mechanic realized the manufacturer's slide/raft component maintenance manual they had been following to pressure test and check their B777 raft bottle hoses at 900 pounds; should have been actually tested at 4000 lbs.
Emb135 flight crew experiences a hard landing after encountering unforeseen blackhawk helicopter's wake turbulence.
B757-200 captain aggressively applies brakes when a baggage cart appeared suddenly while approaching the gate; the area was clear when parking began.

A319 flight crew; upon selecting the gear down; receives a 'nose wheel steering fault' ecam. A go-around is executed; an emergency declared; the procedures are completed; followed by a cabin advisory and an uneventful landing.
A319 flight crew reports tow bar lug on nose gear breaking during push back causing loud bang. After repairs steering produces loud squeal when turning left. Flight returns to gate for maintenance.

B757-200 flight crew at approximately 2000 ft; felt a thump; heard a bang; and smelled something burning. The crew elected to declare an emergency and return to the departure airport to address their concerns.
Turboprop crew on decent to sea received conflicting altitude information from ATC while on the olympia six STAR.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: A B757 crew reports an abrupt pitch up on a false glide slope while acquiring the sea runway 16R ILS at 6000 ft. The crosswinds were strong.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: An air carrier pilot reports that a fueler left the immediate vicinity of the aircraft while the truck was pressure fueling his aircraft.
An A320 crew's approach to ord runway 28 became unstable because they were high and fast at the unanticipated visual approach's start.
An A320 crew returned to the gate with a 'vent avionic sys fault' ecam alert prior to takeoff. After takeoff the crew returned to land when the 'vent skin valve fault' ecam alerted.
An A320 captain reports refusing an aircraft with #2 pack MEL'ed and #1 pack operable but with numerous previous write ups.
B767 flight attendant reports inadvertent slide deployment after being instructed to disarm doors at gate arrival.

An A300 crew reports an uncommanded right roll after takeoff possibly due to contaminated surfaces. The aircraft had been de-iced prior to takeoff but was previously parked in ice and snow an entire weekend.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Climb

text: A LR24 pilot was distracted while entering RNAV arrival lat/long data for an arrival that was not in the gps database and had a track deviation as well as failing to level at the assigned altitude.
Be55 instructor reports total electrical failure while practicing night landings with student. Student lands uneventfully with no lights.
Md80 captain reports tail compartment temp high warning passing FL180 during climb. Qrh is complied with and flight returns to departure airport.
Pa28 pilot reports nmac with helicopter in traffic pattern. Avoidance turn is issued by tower controller.
Small jet flight crew reports runway incursion on runway 32; taxiway left at at mynn due to faded hold lines and signs blocked by bushes.
Pa31 pilot; distracted by passenger; descends 2000 feet below assigned altitude. Attempting to climb and correct the error causes TCAS RA aboard EMB145 at 15000 feet.

An A320 pilot reports on the unprofessional attitude and demeanor of a maintenance supervisor and mechanic; after calling maintenance control about numerous undocumented localized dents on the right lower side of the right horizontal stabilizer.

B717 captain fails to hear call for flaps to 25 as first officer sets FMS speed to approach. This along with possible wind shear causes large airspeed loss and captain assumes control as stick shaker activates.
B777 flight crew starting off across the north atlantic has a pack failure. Crew decides to divert for repairs before continuing to destination.

B757 flight crew elects to divert after a burning plastic smell is detected in the cabin. After the flight a passenger produces a pillow with the burned plastic smell; that was up against the side wall and window at row 35. Window shade is reported very hot.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Cruise
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: Air carrier flight crew returns to MSL to discover two-thirds of the runway lights are inoperative. After reading the FOM crew elects to land with no adverse consequences.
An A320 crew landed on atl 9R; exited at N10 and missed the runway 9L hold short line on taxiway dixie. The crew was surprised at how short taxiway dixie is to runway 9L after passing taxiway n.
B757 FO reports trailing edge flap asymmetry eicas message during approach. Crew goes around; complies with QRH; and makes uneventful flaps 20 landing.
A B767-300 rolled onto the towbar after pushback when the ground crew reportedly disconnected the bar without coordinating with the captain to have brakes set.
An A320 flight crew noticed on taxi out they had dangerous goods on board with no documentation. They returned to the ramp and had the hazmat offloaded.
With captain off frequency B717 first officer accepts clearance for 15 degrees right for traffic but turns left instead. Atc corrects mistake when detected.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An acr flight crew landed in MSL with approximately 75% of the runway lights out of service.
A CRJ700 flight crew arrived at the gate with one engine running and APU shut down; per company procedures; and the fueler hooked up and began fueling.
A319 flight attendant reports missing placards at various locations throughout the aircraft.
B777 flight crew reports capturing a false glide slope during ILS runway 28 approach to ord. Aircraft descends 500 ft before error is detected.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Flight crew of canadair regional jet encounter gear disagree message. Make go-around; resolve the problem; declare an emergency and land safely.

B757 flight crew notices a smoky haze and odor passing 15000 ft in the climb. Engine low oil pressure is noted shortly thereafter and the crew declares an emergency. Uneventful landing ensues with the engine at idle.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Cruise
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: Parachute jump plane pilot reports problems with CTAF and parachute activities frequencies at L65.
C150 pilot on final for runway 26 at clm has conflict with another aircraft on final for runway 08. Discovers CTAF frequency had been changed via NOTAM but was not shown in her current af/d.

On the first flight after painting a cessna C310; a lead mechanic reports the aircraft's nose landing gear collapsed on landing. Nose gear door link rods were not attached and obstructed nose gear movement.
Hand flown RNAV departure from dfw results in a course deviation when the flight crew is distracted by a 'fire detector loop' light and the associated master warning.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Takeoff

text: Ce560 flight crew experiences a course deviation on the banyo four SID from sdl; az.
show: 2008-11 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: Be55 commercial pilot on a sightseeing flight with passengers descended below 1000 feet and entered the uncontrolled traffic pattern at zzz incorrectly; citing the passengers as the primary distraction.
Air carrier crew crossed hpn runway 16-34 after alleged receiving clearance from ground control; confusion whether they were cleared to cross or not was the result.
B737-300 flight crew departing oma; receive pdc without an altitude clearance limit. After multiple clearance limit requests to the tower; first officer is met with an unprofessional response.

A320 captain reports many spurious failure messages upon arrival. Repairs take overnight and ferry fight is refused in the morning when crew learns that the repair does not cover all of the faults reported.

A320 captain has safety suggestion concerning leaving main cabin door open with jetway attached until cargo doors are closed or communication has been established with ground crew. This is to ensure quick verification of cargo smoke ecam with cargo doors open.
Zfw associate controller; providing ojt; described operational deviation when descent clearance was issued without appropriate coordination.
show: 2008-11 · Procedural: Published Material / Policy · Initial Approach

text: Mechanic assigned to remove and replace (right & right); cabin audio tapes on a B757-200; unintentionally stamped the work card item 'no tapes received.'
C421 pilot climbing out of 7000 ft reports loud bang and complete power loss on right engine. Propeller is feathered and flight returns to departure airport for uneventful landing.
Mechanic describes how he inadvertently installed the air sense safety sensor bolt heads in the wrong direction; causing an air turnback of a B737-300 aircraft.
Light aircraft pilot attempts to taxi at sgj after dark without an airport diagram. A runway incursion occurs on each of the three runways while taxiing to runway 31.

C172 pilot plans and flies 3 1/2 hour IFR flight with 5 hours fuel onboard. Flight takes 3 3/4 hours and reporter declares low fuel approaching destination due to fuel gauge readings. Reporter is berated over the phone by controller after landing.
Ce560xl flight crew overshoots 1500 foot altitude restr on the teb 5 departure.
Beech bonanza pilot aborts his takeoff when the engine appears to produce less than full power.
An air carrier first officer was struck in the eye by a powerful green laser light while on a thirteen mile final to aus at 3500 ft. Visual attraction to the light was an involuntary reaction.
An A320 with a pressurization MEL did not pressurize after takeoff when maintenance was improperly performed by maintenance at a foreign airport. Aircraft returned to land.
A B737-500's number 2 engine stalled on start while attempting to start number one engine that was not rotating and distracting the crew. The number two engine subsequently over-temped.
A B747-400 pilot reports that flights with a minimum flight attendant crew compliment are not guarding the flight station entrance to security standards or servicing passengers adequately.

An air carrier pilot reports that HF communications do not work with the new commercial radio service in sbgl and most areas of south america. The result is this air carrier's aircraft are unable to communicate with dispatch in violation of the company's FOM.

A B757 pilot describes the mental confusion and physical action errors during a night approach as a result of fatigue. There was long delay prior to this all-night flight that was supposed to be a daylight flight.

A B737-300 crew departed without consulting a QRH or maintenance after an auto brake disarm light would not extinguish. The flight had a wheels up time that the captain did not want to lose. No takeoff is allowed with an auto brake disarm light on.
A B737-300 wing fuel tank gauge malfunctioned causing a wing vent fuel dump. The previous flight was flown with an undetected out of balance fuel load because of the gauge malfunction.

An A320 crew distracted by maintenance issues failed to turn on the flight directors which maintenance turned off. The takeoff was rejected because of no fma illumination. After the flight directors were turned on a normal takeoff followed.
A B757-200's right engine did not produce rated climb thrust after takeoff. An emergency was declared with a return to land.

A SF340's flight idle stop open light illuminated after takeoff. The crew diverted to the nearest suitable airport after talking with maintenance because no procedures were found in the pilot handbook.

A B777-200 flight crew during preflight experienced a loud noise and unidentified white fibers associated with the air conditioning system in the economy cabin. Maintenance deferred the item; but it recurred enroute; and the flight diverted to an enroute alternate.
A flight crew missed an open circuit breaker on preflight and flew a flight in an illegal configuration.
Loss of all nd's and pfd's due to dual fcu failures causes an A320 flight crew to divert to a nearby airport for an overweight landing.
A B737 slid after parking at a gate whose parking area was made very slippery by deicing fluid applied to aircraft previously parked at that spot.
show: 2008-11 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: An EMB145's automatic pressurization control unit failed at cruise. An immediate emergency descent was begun but the crew did not declare an emergency. The dump and manual pushbuttons are not identified on the pressurization control panel.

During a walk around; a pilot notices a small piece of aluminum tape on the side of an A320. After removing the tape; he noticed a fastener was missing. Maintenance pushing mechanics appears to contribute to the practice.
Md88 cabin attendant informs flight crew of smoke in cabin. Crew declares emergency and proceeds directly to destination for landing. Smoke dissipates prior to landing.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Cruise
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: A da-50 rolled into a fence after the pilot shut the aircraft down but before he could exit the aircraft and install chocks.

A flight crew noticed enroute to destination that they had overlooked a NOTAM that advised one of their alternates was closed. The crew cited antiquated NOTAM abbreviations as contributing to the problem.
Be1900 captain reports getting very close to edge after landing on snow covered runway. A thump is felt and post flight reveals a propeller blade tip is missing.

A11 handoff controller described a near loss of required separation event when traffic was turned on final above and behind a B757 with less than the required distance but then issued a go-around to secure separation.
show: 2008-11 · Procedural: Published Material / Policy · Initial Approach

text: A80 monitor controller described conflict event when aircraft executing missed approach flew through path of a parallel runway departure twice; alleging local controller failed to issue appropriate traffic information.
Cak approach controller described operational deviation event when aircraft entered zid airspace without coordination or handoff; alleging workload and lack of automated handoff's as contributory.
Pa28 pilot reports flying into known icing conditions while attempting to return home for the holidays. Flight lands safely after obtaining IFR clearance and vectors to the ILS.
A80 controller experienced operational error when failing to provide heavy jet separation during triple approach procedures at atl.
Distracted by cockpit setup duties; pilot of beechcraft T34C runs off of taxiway and suffers prop strike while taxiing for takeoff.
A lead mechanic reports on his mistake; and the same continuing problem other mechanics have had installing an incorrect tire/wheel assembly on different series of their B737-900 aircraft.

After performing a 'general visual inspection' of the forward cargo compartment neoprene AFT wall on a B777-200; a maintenance inspector is informed by his supervisor; a downline station found missing and damaged wall fasteners requiring repair.

B767 flight crew reports a missed approach from an NBD approach due to runway not in sight and on a second approach a go-around due to gear doors EICAS. Third attempt is successful. A flap overspeed occurs on go-around.
A320 flight crew reports not checking efb for currency after starting multi day trip. Efb was not updated during the trip as required and was not detected.
A320 captain reports that maintenance is deferring log book write-ups prior to actually complying with the MEL procedure.
Ord inbound accepted descent clearance for another aircraft; reporter alleging air carrier's four digit call signs create addition confusion.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Crj700 captain reports 'auto pressurization fail' at FL350 and climbing cabin altitude. Descent is initiated with ATC approval and control of the cabin is regained during the descent to FL250. Difficulties were encountered reading the labels on the pressurization control panel due to dirt.
A300 first officer reports encountering wave action and turbulence leveling at FL340. Aircraft exceeds vmo by 25 knots and climbs 800 feet.
A320 flight crew discovers enroute that some components of the efb are not current.
Flight attendant on turboprop commuter reports opening the main cabin door with the engine still running after hearing the chime from the flight crew.
Mechanic is informed he changed the 'b' ignitor on the left engine of a crj-900 aircraft instead of the right engine; even though the paperwork he signed was for the right powerplant.
Crj700 departs with incorrect beacon code causing confusion for controller in training.
Dash-8 flight crew report cabin pressurization loss during descent. Emergency is declared with normal landing at destination. Cargo door seal is found to have failed.
Crj-900 landing on runway 24R at cyul heard ATC clear a departure from runway 28 shortly after touchdown; alleging no prior information given regarding traffic or lahso procedures being utilized.
Captain of embraer-145 reports more bags on board than indicated on load manifest. Believes the number may have been purposely falsified by ground personnel.
Distracted by worn prop tape; first officer of saab 340 fails to note one to two inches of missing prop tip on walkaround.
Canadair regional jet returns to departure airport after receiving an anti-ice duct warning message shortly after takeoff.
Canadair regional jet encounters a right wing overheat message while in icing conditions. Divert to nearby airport.
Boeing 757-200 flight crew is unable to get FMS to accept the olympia four STAR while also selecting runway 16R at sea.
A320 flight crew departs without a proper maintenance release following receipt of an ecam sys 2 fault message.
A mechanic working on an A320; unknowingly signed off a maintenance task card he did not perform that checks the trimmable horizontal stabilizer (ths) performance and hydraulic systems.
Be20 flight crew exceeds 1500 ft prior to 4.5 DME on the TEB5 departure.
Ce560xl departing teb receives TCAS ta at 1500 ft on TEB5 departure and turns early to 280 degree heading. Tcas distraction causes altitude overshoot to 1800 ft.
Pilot of cessna 175 is injured when attempting to clear a vapor lock by turning the propeller by hand. Engine kicked back and started; striking his hand.
C182 pilot departing hef northeast bound flies into class b airspace without a clearance.
Zfw controller described TCAS RA event when air carrier level at FL250 responded to a TCAS alert; descent to FL240; reporter citing only traffic at FL210 with inoperative mode c equipment.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Be90 flight crew suffers smoke in cabin and cockpit and considers an off airport emergency landing. Attempt is abandoned when smoke finally dissipates and they proceed to the nearest suitable airport for a safe landing.
show: 2008-11 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Cruise
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: B757 flight crew reports exercising captains emergency authority when center cannot authorize a turn to avoid build ups. Turbulence is encountered as aircraft passes through cloud in turn.
Cl601 captain reports possible tail icing during approach. Flaps 45 causes rumbling and flaps 30 are used for landing.
A90 controller described several automation anomalies that resulted in incorrect aircraft types; routing and flight plan/handoff status; suggesting stars equipment as contributory.
show: 2008-12 · ATC Issue All Types · Initial Approach

text: Beech 77 student pilot reports runway excursion during aborted takeoff on first solo flight.

Air carrier at 17000 ft with zny received TCAS RA with VFR traffic at approximately 17500 ft. Reporter alleged VFR traffic was violating VFR cloud clearance requirements and ATC vectors contributed to the conflict.
Newly instrument rated private pilot suffers spatial disorientation during first actual IMC flight.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: A320 captain departing runway 22L describes concerns regarding compliance with ORD3 SID five mile crossing restr.
show: 2008-11 · Procedural: Published Material / Policy · Initial Climb

text: A B757 ingested a bird on takeoff from jfk. With no significant engine abnormalities the flight continued to its dest where substantial fan section damage was found.

An A320 dispatched with the #1 center fuel tank pump MEL'ed but with fuel in the tank; developed a fuel imbalance because only the left wing tanks were supplying fuel to both engines while using the fuel auto feed system.

An A320 on a night visual approach to las 01L responded to an EGPWS 'terrain; terrain; pull-up' while intercepting the extended final at 5000 ft. Atc advised later that the aircraft was within acceptable minimum vectoring limits.

A B767-300 flight attendant reported electrical fumes near the forward cabin entertainment equipment and found associated circuit breakers popped. The aircraft returned to the gate where the cabin service outlet circuit breaker was found popped in the cockpit.
An A319 crew heard a thump followed by an electrical smell and a 'blower fan fault' ecam. The flight diverted to a nearby airport where maintenance determined the blower fan failed.
A B757 captain turned the aircraft's left pack off at 10000 ft because it created so much air noise; hearing ATC was difficult. This captain recommends removing the aircraft from service.
The front right windshield of a B737 developed multiple cracks at 11000 ft climbing after takeoff. An emergency was declared with a return to land.
A B737 pilot comments that the raas automated alerts are too loud and interfere with ATC communication and flight operations.
An aircarrier pilot reports his aircraft pitching and rolling in response to glideslope and localizer fluctuations at 2000 ft while flying a coupled ILS to sea runway 16L.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Initial Approach

text: B737-400 captain reports navigation database has incorrect crossing restriction on all ILS missed approaches to the south runways at sea. On runway 16L; tebne is coded as 2000A and should be coded as 2000B.
A B737 crew reports a flap asymmetry with flaps at 5degs. This aircraft had the same problem earlier in the day. An emergency was declared followed by a normal landing.

An A320 pilot attempted to have maintenance investigate a single hot brake. The brake temperature was MEL'ed but after the next landing the brake in question was so hot the aircraft was grounded for contract maintenance to repair.
An air carrier pilot describes being confused by a pdc textual clearance revision from rno runway 16R using the reno four departure runway 16L departure procedure.
An air carrier crew's routing was changed from the slc quenn2 arrival to the delta two direct jammn. The crew selected direct jammn then the jammn four and so missed an altitude constraint at heiry.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Initial Approach

text: A crj-700 crew questions the vagueness of mu runway friction reports. A takeoff with mu readings of 19 touch down; 23 mid; and 33 rollout was conducted. The crew later inquired about better takeoff guidance with reduced friction conditions.
Rj flight crew reports getting too low during visual segment of RNAV runway 17 approach at vld. It is noted after landing that neither the runway lights nor the reil's are turned on.

During cat ii landing operations a B737 was assigned sea runway 16L at the faf with an air carrier aircraft in position on that runway. At 1200 ft the departing aircraft was cleared for takeoff. An ILS (glide slope) signal anomaly occured.
show: 2008-11 · Procedural: Published Material / Policy · Initial Approach

text: Air carrier flight crew reports glide slope instability during ILS prm runway 27L at atl. Tower reported back taxiing B757 may have been the cause.

Crj-900 landing at vps at about 1000 feet described event when F18 overflew aircraft starting an overhead approach procedure; ATC failed to issue traffic information; reporter concerned reference potential missed approach need.
Crj200 flight crew reports strong fuel odors during approach after starting the APU for airframe deicing. Apu is secured and fumes go away.
show: 2008-12 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Initial Approach
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: A320 flight crew reports landing gear fails to extend properly during approach. Go around is initiated and landing gear is extended using alternate extension methods. Safe landing with tow to the gate.
Flight instructor landing at rfd reports a near runway incursion by his student when the intended exit taxiway was missed. The reporter cites lack of taxiway f signage as contributory.
Glasair pilot reports nose landing gear fails to extend. Alternate methods of gear extension are attempted without success. Nose gear up landing ensues.
Pilot of a PA32 on an IFR flight plan loses separation with another aircraft when he is distracted by duties associated with recurring high engine oil temperature warnings.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot of small turbojet transport lands to the side of the snow covered runway at bjj. Cites photocell operated runway lights as a contributing cause.
An M20 pilot lost all electrical power shortly after takeoff. The reporter elected to continue the flight to destination under VFR night conditions.

Mechanic reports an MD90 was released without locking out the #2 engine thrust reverser; after flight crew noted the #2 engine performance penalty message illuminated on the overhead annunciator panel.
Fa18 pilot lands on wrong parallel runway after a tacan approach to minimums.
Pa34 pilot encounters severe to extreme turbulence and severe icing while transiting a large cloud on an IFR flight.

Shaken and distracted by an earlier encounter with extreme turbulence and severe airframe icing; pilot of a PA34 begins a visual approach to the wrong airport. Local controller at airport of intended landing advises of error prior to landing.
show: 2008-12 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: An acr crew reports exceeding 250 kts on the gorman four departure prior to ATC's normal speed clearance.
show: 2008-12 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Initial Climb
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: Beech 200 flight crew suffer altitude deviation when altimeters are not set correctly.
A CL600 was flown on two flights with an incorrect weight and balance. The calculations were off by 20 units because of an incorrect weighing.

A light transport jet crew taxiing on stl taxiway f for a runway 12L takeoff; taxied onto runway 24 because they missed the 12L hold short line. Company SOP is for only the first officer to have the airport chart on the yoke.
Two small aircraft had a nmac as one aircraft departed adm while another was on final in opposite direction.
show: 2008-11 · Airspace Violation All Types · Initial Climb

text: Zdc controller experienced operational error at FL290; unfamiliar with aircraft type eventually resulting in an over take situation; corrective action taken was too late to save legal separation.
A B757 crew diverts to an enroute airport after the engine EPR; N1; N2 and egt continuously hunt in flight indicating possible fuel control problem.

A320 flight crew is issued go-around due to runway conditions (snow). Crew elects to divert to alternate and captain is overwhelmed with acars messages. First officer overshoots FL300 due to 29.92 not set and N1 vibration is noted.
B737 first officer describes weather diversion after holding and two approaches at destination airport. Minimum fuel is declared on the way to alternate.
A320 flight crew rejects takeoff when N1 vibration exceeds limits. Crew had previous experience with this aircraft but maintenance could find nothing wrong.
Emb145 flight crew is unable to raise landing gear after takeoff. The crew is informed that a tire has blown; and return for uneventful landing after burning down to max landing weight.
Flight crew of B737-700 fail to note engine bleed switches in off position prior to takeoff. Receive cabin altitude warning during climb.
Flight crew of embraer 190 receives flaps fail message on final approach. Abandon approach; follow the QRH procedure and land ahead of schedule.
A319 first officer reports de-icing crews are failing to insure aircraft are properly configured for de-icing when flight crews are not present to do so.
Beechcraft 58 cfi believes separation issue in the traffic pattern was the result of a trainee local controller being overloaded by high traffic density.
Moderate crosswinds with gusts on landing prove too large a hurdle for low time private pilot.

Upon exiting landing runway; cessna 172 pilot is instructed by ground control to proceed 'to the FBO.' doing so requires crossing an active runway with a landing aircraft on a potentially conflicting course.

While lubing flap rollers on the left wing of an A320; mechanic reports on the low battery charge that caused erratic command movements of the electric man lift that resulted in striking the 2ND inboard flap fairing.
Operator of experimental lsa is unable to restrain the craft from moving after starting the engine with no pilot aboard. Collision with a parked truck results.
Pilot of C210 fails to perform before landing checklist and lands gear up.
Zkc controller experienced operational error between an aircraft level at FL370 and climbing aircraft; inadvertently assigned same altitude; TCAS/RA received by level aircraft.

After being cleared to land; beechcraft 35 pilot is asked to go around when a preceding departure aircraft fails to do so in a timely fashion. Beech pilot; with the departing aircraft in sight; elects to land instead.
Failure to coordinate brake release and pushback results in B737-300 having minor collision with belt loader.
Reporter claims that fatigue induced by scheduling practices contributed to a fuel imbalance anomaly.
B737-700 flight crew misread crossing restrictions on the delta 2 RNAV STAR at slc.
show: 2008-12 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: B737-700 fails to pressurize when flight crew does not note engine bleeds were closed.

Following maintenance on the hydraulic system; dhc-8 taxies out with gear doors pin still installed. Note right main gear door is open prior to takeoff and return to gate for maintenance to complete their job.
A321 experiences compressor stalls followed by loss of oil quantity in the right engine. Engine is shutdown and flight diverted to nearest suitable airport.

A B737-300's lnav would not remain engaged after it apparently was properly engaged. Previously; the #1 engine generator control unit circuit breaker popped and after a second event was MEL'ed. Separately; the standby horizon also failed.
B737-700 captain reports airspeed and altimeter anomalies at FL380; eec's go to alternate mode. Cycling pitot heat switch seems to solve the problem.
A B737-300 engine failed in cruise at FL340. An uneventful landing followed.
An air carrier pilot describes a congested atl ramp blocking his aircraft from completely clearing the runway and so leaving a part of his tail on the runway during cat ii operations.
An MD80's right hydraulic quantity was lost in flight. An emergency was declared followed by a normal emergency landing.

A C172's cylinder head temperature (cht) exceeded 555 degrees f. An emergency was declared but as the flight continued the temperature dropped to 300 degrees f and the flight landed at its destination.

A lead mechanic reports on the confusion and complexity of implementing an airworthiness directive; while using an inadequate picture; that requires different clamps to secure the CL600-2b19 engine idg harness to a fuel line.

Mechanic reports he was not aware that his carrier previously accomplished an engineering change to the cockpit door striker assembly of an A300; resulting in his installation of the wrong part for the assembly.

After troubleshooting a wiring problem of an A320 first officer's sliding window; finishing the window change; completing the paperwork and clearing the MEL deferral; a mechanic is informed the incorrect window was installed.

Private pilot experiences anomalous airspeeds on his primary pfd. Declares an emergency to return to his departure airport. Later turns on pitot heat and problem is resolved. Cancels emergency and returns on course to destination.
C560xl experiences severe turbulence at FL390. No weather was detected by the weather radar.
show: 2008-11 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Cruise

text: An A319 first officer complained about fdc NOTAM procedures; noting listings are often out of date and repeated multiple times; making it difficult to efficiently read and comply with notams. On this particular flight they missed the approach at sea because of a NOTAM that was out of date but included in their packet.
show: 2008-11 · Procedural: Published Material / Policy · Initial Approach

text: Zid controller experienced operational deviation when failing to hand off or point out traffic to sdf tracon during a required delayed climb due to traffic.
Corporate flight crew experiences a runway incursion at the intersection of taxiway d and runway 29R at the 'cat ii holding taxiway 11L' sign in tus.

An A320 captain describes a crew requested late runway change because of a blue hydraulic system anomaly. While maneuvering for night time VFR landing the first officer became disoriented. The green hydraulic system quantity and pressure were also falling.
A320 captain relates an example of what he contends are systemic failures of ramp personnel at iad to ensure ground equipment is kept outside the designated clear area.
Electrical system anomalies and visible 'sparks' from one engine convince Q400 captain to divert to a nearby airport. Captain questions whether an official emergency was declared.
Lr-60 with N90; experienced TCAS RA with VFR traffic. Reporter indicating airspace structure; coupled with ATC practices; contributed to the event.
Passing through the wake of an A321 caused more than 45 degrees of roll that required the use of full control authority by a B737 crew during recovery.
show: 2008-12 · Inflight: Wake Vortex Encounter · Initial Approach

text: A320 first officer advises of a significant reduction in planned fuel on board initiated by dispatch with no coordination with the captain.
B757-200 suffers complete loss of oil pressure on right engine. Divert uneventfully to nearest suitable airport.

Faced with the likely eventual complete loss of crew oxygen while two hours into a transpacific flight; B777-200 flight crew elects to return to departure airport. They later descend to 10;000 feet on captain's emergency authority when O2 pressure drops to zero.

A B737 pilot suggests flight crews inspect aircraft for cold soaked fuel frost (csff) after flight of less than two hours. Air carrier procedures and tools are not available for csff inspections during preflight.

An acr maintenance inspector reports confusion and complexity in applying an airworthiness directive; ad (2001-06-07) and the referenced service bulletin (A601R-24-103) to their company pre and post production cl-600-2b19 aircraft.
An A320 ecam alerted a landing gear shock absorber fault and the nose gear would not retract after takeoff. The crew returned to land after discussions with maintenance.
Media helicopter covering an accident experiences an nmac with another helicopter attempting to cover the same vehicle accident at a co-altitude.
A B777 flight crew on an international flight noted an 'engine response' alert message and ran the procedure. The engine ran normally thereafter.
A BE36 pilot experienced loss of throttle control when a nut on the throttle body came loose. He made a successful landing using propeller pitch; gear; and flaps to control speed.
Single pilot of cessna citation experiences numerous ATC and SID compliance anomalies on departure from teb.

A bae800xp flight crew received a cabin altitude warning horn in cruise at FL410. They declared an emergency; descended; and diverted to the nearest suitable airport; where maintenance found a loose clamp on a duct.
M201 pilot reports critical conflict with unknown traffic entering baz airport traffic area after inability to get timely release from VFR flight following.
show: 2008-12 · Airspace Violation All Types · Initial Approach

text: A mooney pilot experienced low oil pressure and partial power loss so he diverted to a nearby airport. Enroute to the diversion field the engine failed completely and a successful dead stick landing was accomplished.

The pilot of an experimental home built aircraft experienced engine and electrical system failure at 5;500 ft. No restart was possible because of the electrical failure; so he landed safely in a field.
A B757-200ER flight crew experienced a trailing edge flap problem on approach and after running the QRH elected to divert to a nearby airport with a longer runway.
An SR22 pilot experienced loss of oil pressure; shut down the engine; declared an emergency; and diverted to the nearest suitable airport for a dead stick landing.

Flight crew reports inadvertently entering class d airspace while attempting to maintain VMC and using garmin 530 to avoid controlled airspace. Controlled airspace did not appear until map scale was reduced to 20 NM.
show: 2008-12 · Airspace Violation All Types · Initial Approach

text: C152 pilot in traffic pattern reports nmac with piper twin on straight in approach. Piper goes around as C152 crosses runway threshold.
Helicopter operator with cdw; described nmac with cessna during ATC approved practice ILS approach to mmu; reporter's conversation with ATC indicated controller training and controller confusion.
An erj-170 flight crew noted a bleed overpress eicas message. The new captain had some difficulty finding the correct procedure in the QRH; and they elected to return to their departure airport.
CRJ200 flight crew reports strong fuel odors during approach after starting the APU. APU is secured and fumes go away.
show: 2008-12 · Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor · Initial Approach
cat: Flight Deck: Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor

text: A mechanic upgraded to an alternate inspector; is informed by another mechanic; that he; the inspector; had mistagged three B737-700 nose tires. The inspector later describes contributing factors to the mistakes.

Two mechanics and a maintenance controller report on the lack of information available about a required cat-3 downgrade to a cat-1 status of the B737-300 when the stall management computer (smc) is replaced in the #1 position until a hgs cat-3 recertification is accomplished.
Md11 captain reports gen #3 not coming on line after engine start. Maintenance is consulted and the flight departs without disconnecting the idg as MEL compliance would require.
A piper archer on a training flight experienced an nmac with another aircraft.
C172 pilot flies into IMC before obtaining IFR clearance. After IFR clearance is obtained icing conditions are encountered and reporter reverses course and descends without ATC approval.
show: 2008-11 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: C340 pilot reports encountering severe icing conditions at 13000 ft over the rockies. An immediate course reversal and descent is initiated. An emergency is declared and ATC is advised of conditions and new destination.
Crj900 flight crew reports possible tail strike on landing. Tail skid is scratched but indicator pin is not popped. No log book entry is made.
Zid controller voiced concern regarding military operations in rvsm airspace involving aircraft that are not rvsm equipped.
ZKC Controller described operational deviation when adjacent facility failed to comply with LOA routing requirements.

Mechanic reports an outbound captain notices the MEL requirement for entering the B757-200 engine oil consumption as a specific item; had not been complied with. Review of all MEL's was missed during routine overnight (ron) check.

A B777 over the ocean on an international flight experienced fluctuating crew oxygen system pressure. They consulted with dispatch and maintenance; declared an emergency; and diverted to a nearby airport; where maintenance found the indicating system at fault.

A320 flight crew reports fuel puddle under the left engine during preflt. Maintenance determines the leak to be within limits and flight departs. At next station leak is found to exceed limits and aircraft is taken ots.

Flight crew reports crossing ILS hold line for runway 31C at mdw without clearance due to confusion over painted box indicating line is for runway 13L-31R. Airport diagram is similarly marked and also confusing.
B737 flight crew reports ground conflict with stationary crj which is nearly invisible due to night conditions and lack of proper exterior lights.
A319 captain reports engine vibration just after lift off. Engine is retarded to idle and flight returns for overweight landing. Bird ingestion is found to be the cause.

An emb-135 flight crew noticed the sound of nose gear doors opening after takeoff without any abnormal indications. They coordinated with operations and maintenance; declared an emergency; and returned to land.

Two B767 flight attendants describe the fowl condition of an aircraft lavatory. They believe that the unclean conditions create a biohazard for the passengers and crew. Air carrier servicing personnel refuse to adequately clean lavatory.
Deadheading crew member reports ice forming and shedding on the wing upper surface of b737ng during climb out.

A maintenance supervisor and lead mechanic report on failing to notice and enter a required airworthiness release in their dhc-8-Q400 logbook after a major alteration of a flap control unit (fcu) design was accomplished.
Air carrier first officer reports exceeding 7000 foot restriction on POM7 departing ont citing miscommunication with ATC.
Crj-200 flight crew rejects take off when they receive 'idg 2' and 'gen 2' off caution messages. Cause was traced to low idg oil quantity and acceleration effect during takeoff.

A maintenance supervisor; lead mechanic and mechanic describe their involvement with a Q400 APU MEL that was cleared; but later deferred again; due to unclear logbook signoff concerning inspection of the APU combustor drain valve.
Low time private pilot of C172 suffers electrical failure in pattern. Continues to a safe landing over an aircraft awaiting departure on the runway.

Embraer 145 flight crew declare emergency and diverted to nearest suitable airport when they encountered pneumatic bleed failures and inoperative anti-ice systems while operating in wide spread icing conditions.
Cl65 flight crew shuts down one engine and diverts due to out of limits vibration. May have been associated with deicing procedure prior to departure.
B777 flight crew declares a fuel emergency when diversion from zzzz must be made due to weather delays.

While attempting to practice takeoffs and landings in special VFR conditions; private pilot of C172 must make a go-around after landing too FAR down the runway to stop on the paved surface. Loss of separation occurs with an inbound IFR aircraft.
A light transport flight crew at swf miss their right turn on taxiway c. Lack of signage for taxiway c; taxiing from the west; is cited as contributory.
